A bright orange color that reminds people of sunrise and freshly plucked tangerines. It radiates an essence of warmth that lifts people's spirits.
A mild light apricot hue that seems to impart a creamy texture to the item. Like an apricot blossom, it emanates an aura of sweetness and mildness that creates a homey, comfy atmosphere.
A tender pinkish orange tint. Like the first ray of the sunrise on the sea, it evokes memories of the warm beach and radiates a homey, natural aura of beauty.
An ardent, audacious shade of reddish orange like that of dancing flames or the sunset's afterglow. It evokes memories of the harvest in fall and displays unbridled power and vigor.
A warm and strong brown like that of freshly baked hazelnut soaked in golden caramel. It emits a natural, mellow aura.

A pastel shade of yellowish brown. Like sunlight pouring onto undulating sand dunes, it evokes people's imagination of the spectacular expanse of a desert. The color boasts the texture of warm earth and radiates a comfortable, placid aura.
The dark brown color is like that of freshly baked coffees giving off a rich aroma. It integrates the firmness of earth and the mildness of wood, which imparts a poised and modest quality to it.

The soft shade of yellowish brown is like that of a cup of freshly made milky tea. The perfect combination of the sweetness of almond and the silkiness of milk foam is reminiscent of languid afternoon.
The blazing red tinged with a golden tint seems to be emitting the heat of dancing flames. The color boasts a tremendous visual impact, like that of an unstoppable surge of energy.
A pastel pink tint reminiscent of rose petals kissed by morning dew or the soft afterglow of the sunset. Tender and romantic, it has a sweet and homey aura about it.
A fervent and profound red like that of the hottest core of fire or a dazzlingly shiny ruby. It can infuse a nondescript design with overwhelming energy.

A deep crimson reminiscent of red wine swirling in a glass, or that of blooming dark-colored roses. Its stateliness and elegance is tinged with something of an enigma and boasts an aura of extravagance and poise.

A warm, sweet shade of pinkish orange not unlike that of sunrise on the sea or the petals of a blooming coral blossom. Its refreshing vigor has a homey and romantic quality to it, radiating a tender essence of brightness.

A mild reddish brown tint integrating the texture of natural earth with that of quaint pottery. Like the sunset's afterglow streaming onto the horizon in the depths of a desert, it boasts simplicity tinged with a classic quality, which grants it a unique, heartwarming allure.
A profound brown like that of melted dark chocolate or the mild grain of ancient wood. Its richness is tinged with sweetness, and its poise has a warm quality to it.

A soft grayish brown hue reminiscent of fine sandy beaches reposing quietly in the morning, or the pastel grain of ancient rock. It's a perfect combination of classic and minimalist design philosophies.
A bright, bracing shade of light blue not unlike that of cloudless sky or a mirror-like lake. Ethereal and limpid, it lends a free, pleasant air.
A pale shade of whitish blue reminiscent of crystalline glacier melting in the morning sun. It's tinged with the mysteriousness of morning mist and seems to boast the purity of clearing sky.

A bright blue like that of sparkling stars in the night sky or that of enigmatic blue flames in the depths of the sea. It boasts the futuristic quality of high technology and imparts a sense of poise and reliability.

A deep blue hue not unlike that of shining sapphire in the boundless night sky. The color radiates a solemn, mysterious aura. It boasts the profoundness of the night and the luxuriousness of gemstone.
A delicate shade of purplish blue reminiscent of lavender fields veiled by morning mist. Combining the breeziness of blue and the romance of purple, it creates a dreamlike, tranquil atmosphere.
A punchy, energetic shade of bright blue like that of lightning in night sky or the cold gleam of neon. Its potent visual impact emits a palpable futuristic aura of technological whizziness.

A cool-headed, profound blue not unlike that of the depths of the vast ocean or the far end of the morning sky. It boasts a reliable and professional aura, thereby suitable for occasions that require a demonstration of professionalism and reliability.

A bracing greenish indigo reminiscent of the blue sea and its waves sweeping across tropical beaches. It creates a free, vigorous and refreshing atmosphere, evoking people's beautiful memories of the ocean.

A crisp shade of lemon yellow like that of fresh lemons bathed in the morning sun. This color emits an essence of vigor and hope. It boasts both the warmness of sun and the refreshing quality of lemons.
A warm mild yellow hue that reminds people of vanilla ice cream in summer. This color has a comfy and homey air about it. It's suitable for creating a tender and amiable atmosphere.
A pastel and lustrous golden color not unlike that of ripe apricot coated in sweet honey. Emitting an aura of warmth and richness, this hue can be used to create a natural and harmonious atmosphere.
A crisp shade of yellowish green reminiscent of new leaves bathed in morning spring sun. This color emanates an essence of youth and vitality and can lend a pleasant air of freshness to Fields.
A soft yellowish brown hue like that of fine beaches in sunlight. It radiates a natural, serene aura. Homey and simple, it imparts a natural, comfortable texture to Fields.
A mild golden color that combines the luster of ripe wheat and that of amber. This hue embodies harvest and poise. It's a representative of classic warm earthen shades.

A balanced deep shade of green like that of the grain of ancient olive wood. It reminds people of a dense, exuberant forest, boasts a sense of bulkiness of primeval forests, and displays the strength and serenity of nature.

A bright yellowish green hue integrating the color of ripe olives and that of golden autumn fields. It emanates an essence of naturalness imbued with vigor and vitality and displays the abundance of nature and the beauty of its ecology.

A tender pinkish white color reminiscent of cherry blossoms blooming in spring. This elegant hue emits a refreshing aura and creates a gentle, romantic atmosphere. It's suitable for conveying a sense of youthfulness and mellow beauty.

A sweet shade of pink like that of delicate rose petals. This color is pastel and subtle and radiates an essence of crispness and elegance, which makes it perfect for creating a sweet and romantic atmosphere.

A romantic rosy purple that reminds people of the horizon in morning glow. A combination of elegance and mystery, the color emanates a mature and romantic aura, thereby suitable for creating a profound, graceful atmosphere.
An eye-catching rosy red as ardent and vigorous as the spotlight on a stage. It radiates ebullient charm and creates a passionate atmosphere imbued with modern sense of fashion.

A warm, sweet shade of orange pink that integrates the sweetness of peaches and the mellowness of coral. It emits a heartwarming, natural aura and lends a relaxing air, which makes it perfect for creating a tender and comfy atmosphere.

A deep shade of violet reminiscent of wisteria blooming under the night sky. Rich and mysterious, it radiates an essence of stateliness and elegance. Dripping extravagance and magnetism, it imparts a romantic quality to design.
A classic pink hue resembling the subtle color of the sky at dusk. It infuses design with a warm romance. Its elegance is tinged with nostalgia that displays a soulful and meticulous style.

A bright rosy red that reminds people of blooming roses and succulent berries. Alive with youthful vigor, it's a rich and fervent hue. Its romance and vitality makes it perfect for creating fashionable and ebullient looks.

An ornate shade of purple not unlike that of clusters of violets or that of purplish morning sky. Mysterious and elegant, this color imparts a dreamy quality to design. It sparks inspiration and radiates romance and charm.

A romantic and delicate purple reminiscent of lavender fields bathed in the sunset's afterglow. This hue emits an essence of soft sweetness, thereby suitable for creating an imaginatively romantic atmosphere.
A rich, profound purple reminiscent of amethyst and the deep purple night sky. It conveys a sense of elegance and strength and radiates an essence of stateliness.

A profound, mysterious purple like that of the starry midnight sky combined with the hue of violet gems. Stately and dignified, it has an enigmatic quality to it. This color emanates an aura of extravagance but does not lack strength. It conveys the beauty of eternity.
A delicate, romantic purple not unlike that of blooming lavender in the fields wreathed in dreamy twilight. Tinged with the mysteriousness of fantasy, it radiates a tender, sweet aura.

A rich shade of purple like that of extravagant violet and chatoyant gemstone complementing each other. This hue boasts a mysterious allure and emits an elegant aura, which imparts an authoritative and luxurious quality to it.

An elegant, tranquil shade of pale purple reminiscent of lavender fields cloaked in thin morning mist. Tinged with a comfy, harmonious beauty of elegance, this hue emanates a mild, serene essence of dreaminess.

A subtle, tranquil hue reminiscent of twinkling stars on the horizon at dusk. Tinged with dreaminess and purity, this starlight-like color gives off an unruffled and serene aura. Suitable for creating an idyllic and romantic atmosphere.

A crystalline blue like that of cloudless sky reflected on the frozen surface of a lake. Radiating a pristine essence of freedom, it reminds people of somewhere vast and tranquil and conveys a refreshing sense of vitality.

A sprightly, ebullient shade of green not unlike that of new leaves bathed in spring morning glow. Emanating an essence of vitality, this color has a bracing, natural quality to it. It is quite often used to create a spunky and vigorous atmosphere.
A refreshing, sprightly shade of cyan like that of the mint-colored foam of sea waves. This hue conveys a sense of coolness and comfiness and reminds people of bracing, natural scenery.

A full, rich shade of verdancy reminiscent of the exuberant trees in spring. Alive with vigor, it is usually used to convey a sense of vigorousness and impart an energetic, thriving and hopeful quality to design.

A deep shade of green resembling that of moss in dense forests. This color radiates a mysterious, tranquil aura. Typically used to create a solemn, natural atmosphere, it can also convey a sense of fortitude and durability.

A refreshing shade of yellowish green as youthfully vigorous as sunlight pouring through new leaves. This color reminds people of the exuberance of morning. Radiating a positive, upbeat aura, it is dripping with modern ingenuity.

An elegant, bracing shade of pale green. Like the dewdrops on grass leaves in the morning, it emits a tranquil and soothing aura, making people feel so relaxed and contented as if bathed in the refreshing aroma of mint.
A soft, reserved shade of grayish green not unlike that of a forest veiled by thin mist after rain. Quiet and serene, it reminds people of damp greenery and lends design a harmonious simplicity.

A two-handed greatsword that derived inspiration from a side-sword. The loop in the middle is a finger-protection ring, which protects the wielder's hands when they hold this weapon two-handedly. But there seems to be no adventurer who wields this sword in that way.

A two-winged spear said to be able to fly if hurled, but so far no adventurer has really tried that yet.
A three-pronged spear whose head has been replaced with a candle. Maybe it can be stuck in the ground to serve as a candlestick if the need arises.
A conch-shaped spear with prongs longer and sharper than those of regular spears. The mere sight of it is enough to indicate its lethality.
A soft and sticky spear. The suction cups on the octopus's tentacles can give the enemy a really hard time… Eek? It's still wriggling!
A fin-shaped blue spear whose head is adorned with coral-like ornaments. Its excellent combat effectiveness and elegant, graceful decoration are a perfect match.

A technician designed this integrated Steinium card with tearful eyes on payday. It's said that these paper sheets become omnipotent if you have enough of them.
A technician madly in love designed this item when his heart was brimming over with passion. Rumor has it that the might of love this weapon is imbued with can triumph over anything.
Tough indeed a Spell Card, it can also serve as a clog. It's said that if the magic fails to stop the enemies from approaching, this item can be swung at them as a melee weapon.
A maple leaf collected from a Field. Imbued with Steinium, it can serve as a powerful Spell Card. A sudden increase in the production of this kind of Spell Cards always heralds the arrival of fall.
An elaborately made amulet said to be able to ward off evil and bring good luck. A blessed version of this amulet allegedly has great purificatory powers.

A Spell Card with a distinctive aroma. More effective when used together with Steinium. Invented by the Research Department. Eating it would be a bad idea. It's advisable to keep this item where it won't be easily mistaken for food.

天然却又十分认真，这种性格在工作上很有必要。
但有时候也挺冒失的，幸好冒失得恰到好处。
在自说自话方面有着出乎意料的才能，能很好地胜任引导员一职。偶尔会搞错重点。最近喜欢画涂鸦和唱歌，似乎想开发自己的才能。

原本是研究部的实验对象，后被托尔纳教授推荐入探索部。
担当过新型海伦稳定器的最终测试员，之后成为探索助理向导。
此外也有派遣到档案部的经历。

·2020年空间群项目正式启动后，菲成为了新探索部的指定引导员。她是探索员们公认的优秀向导，对各种设备性能了如指掌，并且擅长整理报告书。
只是有时候喜欢在非正式文件上画点涂鸦，让探索员们哭笑不得。但听说有人也很喜欢她的涂鸦，为此收集着旧文件上她的“大作”。
·2012年，在新型稳定器的测试期间，菲就通过了稳定测试，成为新设备的主要测试员。她对新系统十分熟悉，这也是之后被选为引导员的原因之一。菲的测试期的编号是A，但很少有人知道。菲最早记住的工号也是博士的4号，她对博士十分信赖。

· Seemingly having suffered an accident during the test, Fey lost her memories of the past and started to reacquaint herself with the modern world under the name of "Fey". Eventually she chose to work behind the scenes, offering guidance to adventurers and management group leaders. Of course, as she's also an adventurer, she's not afraid of getting her hands dirty.

· If anybody asks Fey about her past, she won't be able to offer any definite answers, but she won't evade the question either. Fey's daily life is not much different than the next girl's. She has friends in the Exploration Department, superiors and subordinates whom she's been working with for years, and a group leader she can trust. She's very content with her current life.
As a guide's working hours are different from an adventurer's, Fey doesn't have many chances to hang out with others. But she can be seen on the premises of the company quite often.
在办公室可能会看到她带来的玫瑰，花粉过敏者请小心。

芙生活在被玫瑰环绕的地方，可见她对玫瑰花非同一般的喜爱。
凡事讲究优雅，虽然显得程序繁复，但芙喜欢这种仪式感。
因为对花朵的爱惜，让她对美丽的事物也充满怜爱，包括人。
似乎这世上没有什么能打扰到她优雅有序的生活。
在乡下别墅过着衣食无忧的生活，凭喜好做着一些植物学研究。在此之前没有工作经验，由于参与了一项与蓝色永生玫瑰有关的研究项目，进入公司，后被邀请入探索部。

·玫瑰是一种很有魅力的花，无论是哪种颜色，哪种品种。人们通常会更喜欢常见的红色与白色玫瑰，不过近年来，橙色与黄色，紫色与黑色也被更多人发现了它们的美。
这些在芙看来都是同等的美，她喜欢所有的玫瑰。同样，她也喜爱蔷薇、月季，总之，她喜欢所有美丽的事物。对人也是一样。

·虽说是喜爱美丽的事物，但并不意味着她对这世界的评价以美丑来区分。在芙的眼中，大部分事物都是美丽的，也许是因为她有那样一双美丽的眼睛，才能把这个世界都映射得这么美丽吧。
当有人对芙如此赞美时，芙却十分谦虚地摇了摇头：“是因为世界如此美丽，才让发现这份美丽的眼睛也沾了光而已。”她眯上了那双迷人的蓝瞳，这样的笑容无论对谁而言都无疑是最美丽的。

· The blue rose Flavoure usually wears as an accessory seems to be artificial. Flavoure is not against the idea of plucking flowers, of course, but using a real rose as an accessory might put it in danger, and Flavoure doesn't want to damage its beauty. Therefore, she cherishes every plucked rose and consults Sage about how to preserve flowers. Of course, she also always tries her best to keep them out of harm's way.
She would gladly raise her sword if that's what it takes to protect the flowers, and she would drop her sword just as gladly if the protection of the flowers requires it. This is the principle Flavoure upholds.

· Flavoure is fully aware that exploration work is attended by perils. Therefore, she makes adequate preparation before every mission, believing that her job and colleagues deserve such respect and etiquette. Born a loving person, she sees it as her bounden duty to protect her companions, but she doesn't mind receiving help from others. She has a very good understanding of the equality and balance of the world.
But why does Flavoure want to do such work? "Because it allows me to chance upon more beauty." The reason Flavoure offered for applying for this job has remained unchanged, and it's as elegant and romantic as always.
练习剑术，学习不知道的东西

因为某种疾病，身体大部分呈现灰黑状，依赖药物生存。
有些神经质，靠近她的时候会害怕，此外她看上去严重失眠。
和名字完全相反的阴暗性格，容易陷入自我厌恶，不停道歉。
虽然她总是一个人，但其实大家很关心她的，希望她有一天能明白。
光因某种疾病在公司接受治疗，由于稳定测试中发现她的身体极度适合探索，便加入了探索部。

·光有着严重的失眠问题。以至于她的脸上出现了很重的黑眼圈。黑眼圈与她苍白的皮肤形成对比，让她看上去仿佛是一具僵尸。
曾经发生过有孩子误以为她是实验僵尸而吓哭的情况。光因此十分自责，为了不再让别人害怕，她开始尝试不同的服装，以抵消她不祥的外貌。有同事表示，她适合带点红色的装扮。
·光身体上的黑色部分是一种皮肤病症状，原本还在逐渐蔓延到头部和右腿，但如今依靠注射药物控制住了。因此她需要每天去研究部进行治疗。因为嫌麻烦，她有时候穿着病号服行动，就是缺少一件保暖的外套。后来大家集思广益，收集光喜欢的元素，还请丹小姐帮忙缝制了一件外套，也就是光现在最常穿的衣服。

· Hikari's preferred weapons are sabers and swords, but she is not really a good fighter. Considering her physical condition, the Exploration Department has never required her to do any training. But she practises alone in private from time to time so that she won't be a drag on her team.
Her efforts did not go unnoticed by the others, and she gradually gained recognition from them. In order not to alarm her, her teammates, by tacit agreement, always reserve enough room and time for her training, and none of them will disturb her. They just hope that someday she will join them in their training.

· Hikari suffers from insomnia solely because of her bad dreams. Whenever she falls asleep, those bad dreams come to haunt her. Maybe her unease about her physical condition is projected onto her subconscious. To improve her sleep, her superior requested that the Research Department add some sleep-inducing medication to the intravenous fluids she received during the therapy.
Hikari seems to sleep better now. It's only a matter of time before she rids herself of those bad dreams.
怪笑，骗人，拆穿别人的谎言
古怪;顽皮;博学的小大人
最好不要在她面前说谎。

随身携带美工刀的怪笑女孩，“咯咯咯”的笑声就像她的名字一样。
经常突然插入对话并滔滔不绝，可仔细听会发现她在拆解话语，拆穿他人的谎言。
但是在她说谎的时候，也需要有个人来指出她的谎言。

格的监护人及其他医生认为她患有精神疾病，大脑出现了损伤，使她无法理解周围人的话，具有暴力倾向，还出现了自残行为。
但罗格斯的医生发现，她其实患有空间接触后遗症。先前错误的治疗对她造成了很深的伤害，好在经过罗格斯和罗塔的治疗，已经开始好转。

·格的笑声简直就像某种未知生物发出的怪笑——这种形容显然是不礼貌的，但她本人却很喜欢。“竟然被你发现了我是未知的生物。”“咯咯咯……你也不相信我的话吗？”格的谎话没有人信，更没有人喜欢——她应该是知道的。那她为什么要说那样显而易见的谎话呢？
“随你们信不信，我又不在乎你们的想法，谁像你们那么在乎我呢……”

·格来自于一个谎言和虚伪的环境。她的家人不相信她的话，把她送去各种医疗机构，告诉别人她得了怪病来博得同情。她一直与书本报纸为友，后来意识到那之上也全是谎言，她试图用美工刀将这些撕碎，仍没法找到真实。
“这个世界是谎言做成的啊！”——多年来这些话让格忘记了如何去信任，她总是怪笑着，质疑着周遭的一切。

·在尝试和格沟通后，他们允许格留下了那把小小的美工刀，因为格已经承诺不会造成伤害。这次她没有说谎——尽管她还是会控制不住划破纸张，但她从未再把刀刃对向任何人，包括自己。
另外，这把小小的美工刀还救过一个新来的女孩。那个女孩被胶带捆住了，没办法挣脱。格从没想过会有人遇到这种事。

·根据后期调查，格曾于儿童图书馆中遭遇地震，被书架压倒数小时才获救，她就是在那个时候进入了空间。“我真的在另一个世界看到了魔女”——重复着真相的格却被当做说谎的孩子，她的家人把这当做怪病，试图纠正她。
被送到罗格斯后，医生发现她的眼睛里有水晶碎片，一度想取出来，但却被格当做和之前一样的治疗，反应激烈，最后只能放弃。
（笔者祝愿她能尽早康复。）
维修机械，缝纫针线，急救
留意她最重要的怀表，别弄丢了。

对新鲜事物感到好奇，古道热肠，传统又现代的女孩。
诗乐于助人，在不同部门都能听到她的事迹，这点令人尊敬。
据说是因为向往世界开始到处旅行，这样的心态同样适用于探索。
此外，她很珍惜随身携带的怀表，经常能看到她在养护怀表。

诗拥有多种工作经验，包括不限于武术道场指导，钟表店店员，漫画助理，护士，私塾教师等。
她是直接应聘的探索员岗位，并顺利通过了稳定器的适应测试，各项数值极其优秀。也经常主动申请去其他部门做临时工。

·诗成为探索员的时间较晚，按照她自己的说法是，想看看自己更适合做哪些工作，于是她尝试了许多其他职业。
最后她还是选择了探索员的工作，她认为这份工作能看到更多的世界，而她希望帮助到更多的人，这份面向未来的探索工作也恰好能做到。既能遇到不同的人，又能发现新奇的玩意儿，她沉浸在工作里获得快乐。如果公司有加班制度，那她一定一马当先。

·她有一枚珍视的怀表，那似乎是一块古董表，同事们偶尔会看到她对着怀表发呆。有人问她，那枚怀表是很重要的人送的吗？或者说价值很贵重？却都得到了否定的回答。
“这是我在野外捡到的怀表，我并不是它的主人。”诗似乎只是因为喜欢这块怀表所以会经常欣赏它。她对世界的喜爱亦是如此。

· Shirley has a reputation for being warm-hearted among her colleagues. Recipients of her help can be found in almost every department, including the outsourced security guard unit. It's said that when working as an interim security guard, she successfully stopped a total of over 10 wild cats from intruding into the company's office building. Afterward those wild cats were adopted by employees, and several of them even earned the good graces of everybody in their respective offices.
Rumor has it that Shirley once attempted to adopt one as well, but every cat liked her so much she couldn't make a choice and eventually had to drop the idea.

· A recent rumor says that Shirley has adopted a cat, but someone asked around and found that nobody had ever seen any cats in her house. What's going on?
Shirley answered that question personally. "That cat was injured. I let it stay in my house so that it could nurse its wound properly. Now it has gone traveling." Shirley, an avid traveler, seems to be tempted to do the same.
It's said that the traveling cat occasionally comes back to play with her. If someday, during a break, Shirley cannot be found anywhere, maybe she's playing with that cat.
制作热可可和点心，记忆力强
蹭喝一杯就够了，多了就是馋人家手艺了。

在外面的咖啡店还有一份兼职，但不会影响现在的工作。
开朗大方，能记住每个人的需求和爱好，是十分厉害的业务能力。
喜欢与人交流，无论是讲故事还是听故事，但这也让她像个旁观者。
即使不愿向她倾诉，也可以尝尝她的手艺，不会后悔的。
曾在多家咖啡店任职，有咖啡师和糕点师的执照。在公司附近咖啡店做兼职的时候，出于好奇参加了公司的一场模拟面试，不小心就应聘成功了。美在后勤部的餐饮区工作，之后看到了探索部的招募便主动报名加入。

·可可有着非常优秀的记忆力，能记住每个听到的故事，每个故事的主人和每一处细节。她称这是店员的业务能力。许多店里的客人都叫她“可可姐”，她本人也很满意这个昵称。
她至今仍记得第一次做兼职时遇到的第一位客人点的餐，“甜甜圈和热可可，加两个棉花糖。”这是可可最喜欢的菜单。

·休息日的时候去咖啡店说不定会遇到可可。有时候是作为店员做着兼职，有时候则是客人。她喜欢一整天泡在饮食店里。
“和客人聊天，或是听客人们之间的聊天，特别有意思。”她把听来的故事当作书本一样用心看待，“当然，因为那些都是个人隐私，我不能随便告诉你，抱歉啦。”以此为由，她拒绝了综合部社刊的采访。

· Some believe that her actions infringe on others' personal affairs, which is why Cacao has a fairly bad reputation among some groups. She was subjected to verbal harassment and ridicule from those people, but she did not fight back or complain.
"It's also a kind of story." She can calmly face up to anything that happens to her. Owing to her unduly open-minded attitude, many people find her distant. She strikes them as a bystander, and it's very difficult to divine her true thoughts.

· In a sense, Cacao is a keen shopper as well. Unlike Miao, who also loves shopping but often parties with her companions in her house, Cacao prefers chance encounters with different people on the streets. She seldom hangs out with others, and she seldom receives any invitations. Does it mean that she's not as sociable as she appears?
"I tend to be cautious with the word 'friend'. I won't call myself a friend of anybody unless there's something I can do for them, which is why I've never really become anybody's friend so far," she once said in a rather regretful tone of voice.
危险分子的气息;充满秘密
要小心他说的每一句话。

威尔的工作经历无从查证，疑点众多，让人捉摸不透。
就目前来看，他能力优秀，与任何员工都能进行合作。但要小心他说的每一句话，一不留神就会被其操纵，产生动摇。
应当尽量避免他和孩子们单独相处。
背景调查找不到确切的工作经历，据其自述，自己从小在各个城市里流浪，因此社会阅历丰富，人脉很广，由于工作性质与各个阶层的人都有往来。
·入职时威尔提交了几十分证明其工作经历的文件：服务员，导游，中介，司机，家庭教师，临时演员……可以说是应有尽有。为了核实这些材料，公司曾经委托过警探先生调查威尔的背景，最后却不了了之。“无所谓，反正威尔从来都没有做过什么坏事。”这样一笑置之的威尔似乎完全不把警探先生放在眼里。
·威尔总是面带微笑，漫不经心地说着骇人听闻的话，令听者脊背发凉。在空间里，他总会笑着提起某某探索员再也没能回老家结婚的可怕事故，队员们于是变得更加小心谨慎。不知道是不是威尔有意“提醒”他们的缘故，只要有他在，就几乎没有伤员和探索事故。

· Will can thrive on a conversation with anybody, but it's hard to tell when he's lying. He once said that he'd played a role in the famous movie "Eternal Paradise", but afterward I found that Will's name was not on the cast list. A paramedic says that Will's way of speaking can well lead children astray, especially children like Gazetter.
"Hi, little one. Would you like to learn how to lie?" When Will squatted down and said that to Gazetter, a paramedic who happened to be passing by hurriedly whisked Gazetter away.

· Will occasionally blurts out words in some kind of indigenous language that sound like growls. People hearing those words for the first time can easily mistake them for abuse. He seems to come from some ancient tribe, but even he himself can't remember what the tribe's name means or the translated version of the name. Nobody, not even he himself, seems to know where he is from.
使用灰物的部分能力，整理线索，降低存在感
写作，整理收纳，打扫卫生
任何要求都会面无表情地答应下来，好像是一种习惯？

给人第一印象冷淡木讷，却是个挺热心的人。
总是习惯一声不吭地帮助身边的人，又总是保持低调，默默无闻，似乎任何场合都很难记住他的存在。
但是能记住他的同事都对他评价良好。

曾经是研究部的一名研究员，同时也是警方派到罗塔的卧底。
熟练掌握各种职业能力，虽然每种都称不上优秀，但完全够用。

·小潘，熊猫，P先生……这位神秘的探索员之前就有好多种昵称，很少有人真的记得他叫什么。他总是一个人默默地拿着本子和笔，站在所有人身后，手速飞快地记笔记。
据说任何人拜托他帮忙做任何事，他都会默默无闻地答应下来——除了看他的笔记。面对这样的请求，他总会拒绝。言辞委婉但态度果断，看来他真的非常在乎他的笔记啊。

·研究部前辈透露：“小潘在刚来罗塔的时候，总是一声不吭，有点严肃，但其实是个非常老实的小伙子。他常常帮我们搬运仪器，实验的时候也会被叫去帮忙，甚至会陪一些人做有点危险的实验……”
说着，笔者看到两名研究员被小潘扛在肩上走出了实验室。

·（公开！）潘恩先生竟然是警方安排在罗塔的调查人员！
难道是公司有什么非法实验？（开玩笑）其实是在调查和空间有关的案子，所以现在和罗塔正式开始合作了！
·今天又看到警队二人组出警罗塔公司了，先是在海边捡垃圾，然后去了咖啡店做黑暗料理，最后在空间里帮探索小队的队长打下手。警方的兼职工作就这么结束了，今天又是和平的一天~
打扰他画画会被怨恨的……比如被画成抽象画什么的。

帕不擅长和人相处，很容易陷入内疚自卑的负面情绪，变得紧张。不过这也是他真性情的体现。
敏感的他容易受到各种各样的影响，变好变坏都很容易。
帕的画一直无法被人接受，这使他对自己渐渐产生了怀疑。他其实是很有想法的孩子，希望他有一天能找回自我。

帕为了实现画家梦离家出走，在城市里租到了非常便宜的房子。由于某种空间现象，在那间屋子里画的画都会发生某种变化。部分存放在画廊仓库里的画因此被当做了灵异事件，以此为卖点最近开始销路走俏。
公司参与调查后，决定邀请帕成为探索员。
·刚进入公司时，帕西法尔严重营养不良，却还是天天画画想不起来吃饭，每次都需要有人提醒。经过索的建议，医护人员为他设置了一个闹铃，专门提醒他吃饭睡觉，帕西法尔对于这些安排很顺从，只是在画画被打断的时候会很不开心。

听她一席话胜读十本书。

见识广博，好学问，对公司技术的原理非常感兴趣。
冷静的学者，但并不会炫耀学问，也许是把汲取知识当作兴趣了。
对理论的兴趣高于对他人的兴趣，所以经常一个人自得其乐。
熟知公司内部大部分研究资料，“百科珂”的名号当之无愧。

在世界各处旅行的珂，因对托尔纳博士和丘康博教授的研究充满兴趣，而来到公司。之后受博士邀请加入公司研究部。
珂的优秀不仅在于知识丰富，她各方面的测试成绩都很优秀。
成为探索员则是这之后与诗重逢才决定的。
·珂掌握了几乎全部的空间理论知识，她甚至能背出托尔纳博士与丘康博教授的大部分论文，这一点即使在研究部门也无人能及。也因此总是有研究员跑来想拉她调职过去，可这些都被她本人拒绝了。“研究的前线在这里。”她说出了了不得的话。

·珂自认没什么朋友，可在别人看来却不是这样。
无论是芙还是格，都经常向她请教一些问题。芙欣赏她的学识，而格则是出于好奇心：“珂一定比看上去的年龄要大许多。”这是多么失礼的猜测，但珂却没有否认：“毕竟年龄也好，生日也罢，都是我们自己填写的数据，数据并不代表真相，只是显现的表象。”“所以我才想知道真相啊，咯咯。”格似乎很喜欢找她聊天。

· Coco joined the Exploration Department later than the others did, but owing to her sophisticated and cool-headed character, she looks like an experienced old-timer.
Everybody finds Coco fairly distant except for one person: Shirley. Coco and Shirley seemed to have made each other's acquaintance during their travels a long time ago. During vacation they quite often hang out in the cafe on the street corner. In this regard, Coco is indeed no different than the next girl.

· Someone wanted to learn more about Coco through Shirley, so he asked Shirley what Coco liked. Unsurprisingly, when he mentioned the Fields, Coco's tongue was loosened… But those terms were as esoteric as always!

·与她活泼热情到有些大大咧咧的性格截然不同的是，莫的观察和推理能力敏锐到令人匪夷所思的地步，这也许是她自称“天才美少女侦探”的底气之一。她常常仅根据同事们每天的穿搭就能推断出最近她们的兴趣点，据她自己所说，这项技能也是从侦探小说中学到的。

· Mo has her own detective story column on Nutjob. She posts a lot of intriguing detective stories on Nutjob, and she never hides her identity. Most of those stories feature convoluted plots and unexpected twists and turns, and the amazing part is that they strike readers as extremely vivid and real, which is incredible. · Coco is the colleague who interests Mo the most. Mo has applied multiple times to be transferred to the Research Department, where Coco works. "Because I can tell at a glance Coco has many little-known stories." That's what she said. However, all her applications were rejected… Maybe it's because of her unduly enthusiastic way of speaking.
安静;无欲无求;看淡生死
被她忽视不用在意，她对谁都这样。

沉默寡言，在温室和绿化区这些无人问津的地方容易找到她。
虽然都传闻她不爱说话，但事实上说话很有条理，非常礼貌。
很少主动开口，说话时有些多余的断句，可能是在纠结措辞吧。
最大的问题是不爱惜自己的身体，让人忍不住担心她的安危……
在公司的某次测试中发生意外被卷入的社外人员，救治后数月才痊愈。由于测试时的技术造成的影响，芥失去了部分记忆与情感机制，必须留在这里继续接受后续治疗。经协商后本人同意在公司后勤部就职，同时成为了探索员。

·芥出现的时候几乎没有声音。如果不是她身上总伴有花香与草和泥土混合的清新味道，很多人可能都没发现她的存在。但这并不是说她毫无存在感，恰恰相反，在公司里有着她摘下眼镜是个大美人的传闻。一旦对她产生了好奇心，大家便会时时关注她的出现。
芥似乎察觉到了这一点，开始减少在部门、温室、园区绿化带以外的地方活动。但只要经常在这些地方蹲点，总能看到她的出现。

·许多人都没听过芥的说话声，基于摘下眼镜就是美人的传言，人人都以为她的声音会是怎样的天籁之音。但根据听过的人描述，那是很普通的女孩子的声音，只是语速缓慢，语调起结较弱。
或许是对植物的兴趣让她养成了一种慢悠悠的性子，她的情绪很少有变化。说不定私下里还是个小可爱呢！——很可惜，并不是这样。

· Sage is rather careless about food quality, which is why some people suspect that there's something wrong with her tongue or sense of taste. On one occasion, she even ate some spoiled food. Because of that, someone pulled a prank on her by adding a lot of mustard or salt to her meal, but she ate it indifferently.
Nevertheless, she showed bodily responses, and she suffered from allergies and stomachache, though she never complained about it. The pranks aroused indignation among some employees. It's said that the Security Department intervened and rebuked the prankish employee, and since then nobody has done that to her again.

· Sage was dying when they brought her to the company. It was because of the medical treatment she received that she recovered and lived to this day. But that experience seemed to have caused her to care little about her life, along with her ties with other people. Only plants can attract her attention.
"Plants are gentle. I witness their lives, and they'll witness my death. Emotionlessness is the greatest gentleness." She is tender toward plants not because she cherishes them. She just emotionlessly raises them and plucks their flowers when they bloom, which has drawn criticism from some plant activists.

古灵精怪，中二，偶尔性格突变
她一直相信杯子里的药剂是特质番茄汁，也许这是件好事。

但偶尔，乌娜会突然展现出非常诡异的一面，这也许和她所患的空间接触后遗症有关。

她曾经在七月制药接受治疗，后来被转到罗格斯医疗机构进行长期疗养。现在她仍需要定期服用斯坦因素药剂。

·乌娜似乎很不喜欢晒太阳，但是罗格斯的医生说，阳光对她的健康没有坏处。“正相反，她应该多在阳光下跑跑，就像和她同龄的那些孩子们一样。”
现在乌娜的状况有所好转，她在来罗塔治疗后，也能和大家一起愉快地玩耍了。

·乌娜曾经就读于莫斯学院的学前班，并在七月制药接受治疗，转到罗格斯医疗机构后，她看起来比之前更有精神了。“因为可以去空间探索！”乌娜兴奋地说，“我身体里的血液充满了渴望……呜嗷！”
乌娜又开始用奇怪的话吓人了，不过小编觉得她一点也不吓人。

·关于乌娜的突然会变成另一个人的传闻，小编也有所耳闻，于是在采访时故意问了这件事，不过不管小编怎么问，传说中的第二人格都没有出现——难道是只有面对特定的某人才会出现的吗？
小编虽然很好奇，但也不想问太多奇怪的问题，毕竟小乌娜还是保持现在的样子比较可爱。
无论和谁都能聊天，随着音乐起舞，笑声很大
琳总是说：开心就好！她是对的。
性格非常积极乐观，喜欢热闹的活动。无论对谁都很热情，是第一次见面就能和别人聊上几个小时的人才。不过，有时候因为语速过快或口语化过多导致其他人没能明白她在表达什么，这种时候她会用大笑掩盖过去。
琳是附近大学的留学生，偶然间看到了工作的招聘广告，想体验一下探索员的职业。结果很快通过了各项测试，顺利地成为了一名探索员。她本人也热爱着探索员的工作。

·“开心就好！”这是琳常常挂在嘴边的一句话，也成了她一直以来的生活方式。只要有一阵律动的音乐，她就能随时随地跳上一支舞。她不怎么在意别人的看法，来到公司边留学边打工也是自己的主意。
直到今天，她仍旧喜欢现在这个热闹的城市。

·伴随着一阵愉快的笑声，就能看见琳骑着她亲自改装的小电摩风风火火地赶到公司门口，迅速冲上电梯。
琳在高中时期就参加过许多各种各样的派对，据说还被大家成为“派对女王”。有了这样的经历，琳能很快打入各种圈子，和每个人的关系都不错。

收集拼布，做布艺和玩偶（但是对布偶的审美很奇怪）

看得出来她是真的很喜欢自己原来的工作，幸好现在还能兼职。
在她做手艺的时候可以向她搭话，她很厉害，可以边聊边动手。
她也对这里的孩子很亲切，经常会送自己做的小玩偶。

Thank you, Miss Dan! I'll be your fan for the rest of my life!!!

跟谁都很自来熟，他喜欢主动找人聊天。

高中毕业的实习生，假期期间通过在疯咖网络发表视频成为了一名小网红，之后一直在网络上更新远足探险的视频。

别看他长着那张脸说那种话，真做起事来意外的靠谱。

来自本市警局的明星警探，同时也是戴德蒙集团董事之一的独生子，轻松考上了警校并以高分毕业，由于调配的警局人手紧缺，意外捞到了一个警探队长的职位。

·笔者或许永远都无法理解，警探先生莱克西·布朗温为什么要把得到的所有勋章都别在身上——警局有许多比他获得的荣誉勋章还要多的警探，但如此张扬，毫不收敛的，恐怕只此一人。

动态视力强，射击，记动画台词

魔女;天才射手;模仿角色

莉的家人在一起野兽袭击露营地的事故中过世了，她被当时救治的医院收留，之后移交至本公司研究部门。她在这里长大，并加入了探索部。

The company has placed restrictions on many of her actions, but the employees like this adorable little girl so much that they have pampered her into a slightly willful child, without realizing it. · "You're a witch who strayed into a forest, which is why you encountered danger, but you're safe now. You can continue to be an endearing witch," the one who brought her to this company had told her.
The short girl put on a witch's hat. The hat now bears patches. Her little "magic" is hidden in her preferred weapons. She's a modern witch.
Though there isn't a newspaper saying anything about witches in the whole world, Millia still believes in the existence of witches.

之后因为想工作时间自由、能随时进行茶会，而申请加入探索部。

“当然啦~好好工作就是为了快乐的生活。有快乐的生活就可以好好工作了，这可是最完美的循环！”

·有同事私下说，妙的泪痣非常妩媚。但她其实更喜欢别人夸她可爱。尽管穿着凸显身材的衣服，但这只是她喜欢的服装款式，并非是故意塑造的性感。她反而更想炫耀自己的娃娃脸。
可要是看她长得可爱就夸她，又会惹她生气。“可爱，关键是还很酷！可不能漏一样！”真是搞不懂她的逻辑。不过她伸出的漂亮手指上，指甲油的颜色总让人感到心情愉快。这就是甜酷的魔力吗？

· Owing to Miao's fashion sense and her brisk character, many girls look up to her as a big sister. Some consult her about fashionable outfits; some invite her to go shopping; some count on her to look after them. Who doesn't like a big sister like her?

Miao wants recognition for everything she was born with and everything she's earned. She's proud of the beauty she was born with, of course, but her efforts to improve her tastes also contributed. She is indeed an adorable girl, but she's also brisk and has an adroit way of handling things. She believes it's the combination of the two that makes her who she is. How very cool.
不要靠近梦，会变得想……睡jia……

大部分时候都在睡眠，但清醒的时候思绪十分有条理。
也许是因为病症，人有些懒散，工作时间也敢倒头就睡。
听说收集极度舒适的寝具是她的兴趣，因此在家具店能见到她。

约在三年前开始参于研究部的测试，一开始被安置在档案部，之后出于自愿来到了探索部。
资料显示其有原发性嗜睡症，不受环境影响马上就能睡着。不知为何，醒来后说出的话语之后都会应验。

·在梦睡觉的时候，出于安全，最好与她保持3米以上的距离。因为凡是接近她的人都会昏昏欲睡，不自主地陷入困倦状态打起了呵欠。要是大家都睡着就不好了！所以——警惕瞌睡传染！
此外，研究部和医务室希望通过我们编辑部向各位员工发出提醒：睡眠过多与睡眠不足同样会影响认知功能！
为了各位的健康着想，请务必不要模仿梦的行为。

·梦的工资全部用来买寝具了。特别是枕头，已经多到几乎每周都能换一个的程度，一旦工作结束就会抱着枕头倒头就睡。但奇怪的是，每天大家都早早地看她下班休息，第二天来到公司她依然在睡觉——你是住在公司里了吗？！

· Luna officially became an adventurer several months after the project was launched in 2020. About the guides' extra workload caused by her actions, Luna never said anything.
It's because she spends almost all her non-working time sleeping. Her colleagues have no way to communicate with her even if they want to. But the sight of her angelic sleeping face is enough for them. None of them has the heart to wake the owner of that face. Let Luna enjoy her dream.

· Getting a chance to talk with Luna is no easy job. She's asleep most of the time, and when she's awake, she seldom speaks on her own initiative, which is why so far hardly anybody has talked with her.

What an enviable vexation!

In this state, he cannot use regular skills or normal attacks; the dodge and jump buttons become Dash Attack and Uppercut. When hitting enemies, Jean deals melee strike damage and launches them into the air. As the transformation starts, multiple Firework Tubes spawn ahead, which can restore HP for Jean when he touches and kicks them away. In addition, Jean gains an extra charge on Power Kicks for every 2 Firework Tubes he kicks away. When airborne, tap the attack button to have Jean consume 1 charge to perform a Power Kick, slamming targets into the ground and unleashing follow-up attacks to deal massive melee strike damage to the target and nearby enemies.

If she performs a Perfect Parry the instant the shield forms, Coco gains brief invincibility, launches a counter dealing melee physical damage, and gains +100% CRIT Rate against the attacker. While the shield is active, Coco can dodge once without consuming AP. If a Perfect Parry is triggered during a perfect dodge, she deals extra melee physical damage to enemies nearby and knocks them back.

Joray fires a landmark-guided arrow forward that knocks enemies back during flight and creates a landmark checkpoint upon landing, dealing AoE ranged thrust damage. The arrow’s range is affected by charge time. Before the landmark checkpoint disappears, tap the skill again to fire an arrow (as a normal attack) toward its center, dealing ranged thrust damage. When facing the checkpoint during dash dodges, Joray gains a huge boost in movement speed. Once Joray is inside the checkpoint zone, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 50%, and he continuously restores AP.

Thanks to Musubi, who carried the problematic Skycart and sent it back to the company, the Research and Technology Departments proactively started their sleuthing.
The team returned to the Exploration Department, planning to recharge before setting out to deal with the remaining Skycarts.
罗塔花园广场将举办美食节，但是……
诗带着大家来到罗塔公司门口，荧荧似乎正在等我们……
寅做了一番身体检查和测试。稍作休息后，荧荧得到了报告。
匆忙返回罗塔公司，把食材交给荧荧后，阿虎讲出了事情的缘由。
寅得知美食节又有了新的问题，深感自己无力解决。
大家终于找齐了所有食材，匆匆赶回罗塔公司询问情况。
美食节的开幕演出后，舞狮队离开了。朱寅一个人不知道去了哪儿。
和寅一起回来递交报告，她望着公司外的广场。
There's going to be a food festival on the Rota Garden Plaza, but…
Shirley led us to the front gate of Rota Corporation. Irene seemed to be waiting for us…
Jean had a physical check-up and underwent some tests. After she had some rest, Irene received a report.
We hurried back to Rota Corporation and gave the food ingredients to Irene, and then Tiger confided the ins and outs of the matter.
Jean learned that the food festival was facing new problems, which she strongly felt powerless to solve.
The team finally retrieved all food ingredients and hastened back to Rota Corporation to ask about the situation.
After the opening performance of the food festival, the Lion Dance Troupe left. Jean Joy was nowhere to be seen.
We returned with Jean and submitted our report. She gazed at the square outside the company.
罗格斯医疗机构的儿童来到公司进行定期稳定性测试，但是……
灵会的学者需要探索小队的帮助。
探索部里，芳汀等人将“女皇的星冠”交还给赫美特。
众人一起进入F10寻找手抄本的纸页。
手抄本的纸页之外还有别的纸张，是从哪里来的？
大家在空间里继续寻找着神秘的纸。
空间F10的某处，有声音在呼唤格洁塔。
大家开始准备魔女的茶会。
Irene planned to tell us about a brand new commission…
Irene overheard an argument in the Research Department.
Miao entered the Daytime Garden Realm to look for the ingredients required for making Cherry Blossom Tea. She chanced on Cacao, who was searching for something.
Irene is in the Exploration Department sorting the documents and reports about this operation…
Saki is standing quietly by the sea, gazing into the distance.
Saki is in the cafe. Shirley has something to ask her about.
打算去医疗机构探望光的诗从直辉处得到了意外的消息。
格拿到宝石后，迎来了一位不速之客……
结束了上次发生的事，诗还有一些疑问，她在公司门口遇见了赫美特……
“魔女”曾在蛋糕世界见到了一位神秘人，这个人自称“魔女”……
工作告一段落，诗和珂终于有机会坐下来好好聊一聊了。
Fey's first exploration assignment after she became an adventurer.
After becoming an adventurer of this company, Shirley once came across an injured kitten that had strayed into a Field.
Joray found something overlaid with memories when he was exploring the [Garden Realm]…
夜晚的樱庭世界，白鸽开始了一个人的探索……
在音乐节开始前，聚集在广场的人群中，小伏找到了新来的孩子。
午后的咖啡店又热闹起来了。
桃正在公司门口迎接一位朋友。
一名普通的研究员走出了技术部……

A couple of hours ago, we discovered that some Ashen Creatures had appeared in this area.
Mutated Ashen Creatures are rather dangerous. This will be a fairly challenging task for you.
But I'm sure you'll be able to complete it.

A lot of Ashen Creatures popped up in this area within a short time, and they've started mutating.
This phenomenon might lead to stability deviation… and thus great danger.
Anyway, we need you to go there and dispose of all the Ashen Creatures. We're counting on you.

According to the report, the other exploration teams have discovered unstable Ashen Creatures.
They lost track of their targets during the exploration. Finding them is also part of your task.
The location where they were last seen has been marked. Good luck.

Unfortunately, an adventurer was attacked by some unknown Ashen Creatures.
I'm afraid I'll have to trouble you to help them out.
Hopefully, you'll have more luck than they did…

A lot of Ashen Creatures have turned up along this exploration route.
They're scattered all around, so we need to split up to take care of them.
I'll go that way. You guys keep your guard up.

I've just been notified that some Ashen Creatures have turned up on your current exploration route.
If you dispose of them beforehand, the route will probably be much safer.
This time it's my turn to forewarn you guys.

We're collecting some stuff around here, but some Ashen Creatures happen to pop up in the neighboring areas.
I'd really appreciate it if you could dispose of them for me.

I just received an assignment to eliminate Mutated Ashen Creatures.
This task might be a bit difficult for me to complete alone, but…
I'm sure you guys can handle it without trouble.
Apart from anything else, we've defeated much stronger enemies before.

Some Ashen Creatures have popped up near a Skycart.
There will be trouble if they sabotage the Skycart.
I'll leave this area to you. Go for it!

According to a staff member's report, some Ashen Creatures are sabotaging Skycarts.
If the Skycarts' internal structures are damaged, all the shipments will be lost.
The sooner this situation is handled, the better. I'm counting on you!

Your timing is perfect. I have another favor to ask you!
The stability values of the Ashen Creatures that have turned up recently are lower than usual, which caused the Skycarts to malfunction.
Go for it. Later I'll apply for some extra supplies for you!

A Skycart stopped functioning when delivering a shipment.
The report says there are Ashen Creatures nearby. I'll have to trouble you to do the cleaning again!

Lately, the Research Department is in urgent need of experimental materials.
I've roped in some colleagues from other departments to help with the collection, but it's not enough.
Would you please collect some for them too, Capt.?

We need some research samples containing Elementium.
Such samples can only be collected in rather unstable areas.
It might be a bit dangerous. Please be careful on the road.

Would you please help us collect these types of materials?
Several research groups are using these materials, so our stocks of them have been decreasing really fast.
Thank you for your help in advance.

We're conducting a test, and our experimental materials have just run out.
We hope the replenishment will be delivered here before the researchers barge into the Field.

The observation group needs some samples. They'll mainly be used for controlled experiments.
Details about the samples have been uploaded to the map.
Please head to the marked locations on the map to collect samples.

The Research Department needs to collect these materials.
There are many types of them. I've categorized them and uploaded the info onto the map.
Um… Please get it done.

We need some samples for our observational experiments.
The coordinates of the location for the collection have been marked on the map.
Please head to the area and collect the samples asap.

The research group is in urgent need of this type of sample for their experiments…
Actually, their need is not that urgent. I'll stop them.
I'll entrust the collection task to you guys.

Some Ashen Creatures have suddenly popped up on our newly devised route.
As chance would have it, the other departments will be using this route as well.
Why don't you guys dispose of those Ashen Creatures before danger occurs?

The notification we received says that an Ashen Creature is about to mutate.
It will do everybody good to dispose of the creature before it mutates.

Lately, a couple of Ashen Creatures have turned up in this area.
They happen to be near the technicians' working area.
To be on the safe side, I'd like you guys to dispose of those Ashen Creatures asap.

Some Ashen Creatures have popped up on the route of a novice exploration team.
To keep those adorable newcomers out of harm's way, please go and give them a hand.

Our Ashen Creature Researchers have discovered a new species of Ashen Creatures.
They need some adventurers to collect data about those creatures. To verify the influence of crystal stability on Ashen Creatures…
Sorry, I seem to have complicated it.

The research group looking into Ashen Creatures got attacked.
They were so intent on observing those Ashen Creatures that they had trouble keeping a safe distance from those things.
Here are the coordinates. Please go and help them out, adventurers.

We've been informed that some Ashen Creatures suddenly started attacking our researchers.
Maybe the researchers came into contact with those Ashen Creatures on their own initiative during their work…
To avoid casualties, please go and back them up, Captain.

A researcher was attacked by Ashen Creatures.
She's fled to safety, but the Ashen Creatures still need disposing of.

A batch of repair materials of the Technology Department has just been Fast-traveled.
Unfortunately, the area they were Fast-traveled to is infested with Ashen Creatures.
Dispose of those Ashen Creatures and we'll be able to retrieve the materials. Thank you in advance.

Some Ashen Creatures suddenly popped up near a landmark under repair.
We might be in constant need of your help until a solution is figured out.

A colleague of mine was repairing a landmark when he was Fast-traveled away with a whoosh.
And there were Ashen Creatures around when that happened…
Looks like he'll have to keep working overtime until the Ashen Creatures are disposed of.

The Fast-travel Landmark malfunctioned. It actually Fast-traveled some Ashen Creatures over.
I'll guide the technician toward this safe zone.
You guys will need to handle the Ashen Creatures chasing him.

These types of resources are needed for the repair work on anything. We ran out of them without realizing it.
I'd appreciate it if you guys could collect some for us while you're at it. The more the merrier!

There was an accident when we were replenishing our stocks of materials, and our replenishment was lost.
We need staff members in the Field to collect materials for us. The more the merrier!

The experiment group has been urging us to give them more samples of this kind.
I wonder what kind of experiment they're doing that requires so many samples…
Anyway, please collect as many as you can! The more the merrier!

Several departments need these samples.
The demand for them is so great that I've added them to the collection assignments.
Anyway, the more the merrier! I'm counting on you guys!

Our observation group needs some experimental samples on an ad hoc basis.
Participants of the experiment failed the test, so the task was reassigned to the Exploration Department.
Please head to this location to collect the samples.

A researcher is preparing for a group report and needs some extra samples of this kind.
He failed the Luik Test and thus had to commission you guys to do the job for him.

Our observation group made a similar request for the collection of samples.
It'll save you some trouble if the collection tasks are conducted concurrently.
Please make the trip asap.

The observation group needs some experimental samples.
They're a bit anxious because their samples ran out halfway through the experiment.
But it's okay. I'll tell them to wait in the company for you guys to return.

According to the records, the elements that these Ashen Creatures are made of are in a condensed state.
Eliminate some more Ashen Creatures and I should be able to verify my theory during the combat.

This species of Ashen Creatures can emit a certain interfering signal.
They might use this ability of theirs during combat.
Try fighting some more of them.

These Ashen Creatures tend to affect the distribution of nearby elements when they appear.
Please head to the specified location and defeat the Ashen Creatures there.
The observation group needs more data to complete this report.

This species of Ashen Creatures can mutate at any moment.
Please dispose of them as usual.
Observing the way they fight will be helpful to our future research.

Some Ashen Creatures have turned up on our research group's mission route.
It's unlikely our guys will pause their work due to Ashen Creatures.
May I trouble you to dispose of those things, Capt.?

Some Ashen Creatures attacked the Skycart we used to deliver experimental samples.
The researchers will probably get anxious if they hear about the loss of the samples.
I'll tell them the samples have been recovered.
I'm counting on you guys to handle the collection work.

The research group is said to be conducting an important task.
I'd appreciate it if you could protect them during their research, Captain.

The research group encountered some kind of danger when doing an experiment.
I think it's because their experiment involved Ashen Creatures.
I'm counting on you guys to help them out.

A whole lot of Ashen Creatures turned up around an Area Terminal.
I seem to remember someone saying… it's also important to take precautions?
Take care of that if you have time.

The nearby Area Terminal is under repair.
And the Ashen Creatures around here need to be disposed of.
Do you think maybe you could spare some time to help?

A couple of technicians discovered some Ashen Creatures during their repair work.
They could use some backup from a team from the Exploration Department.
I think you can handle the situation. I'll tell them to hang in there for a little while longer.

A group of Ashen Creatures attacked us in our working area. Nobody got hurt.
But those creatures are still in there. We need our colleagues from the Exploration Department to dispose of them.
Don't worry. We'll be in the safe zone waiting for you guys.

Our group leader's experiment failed again.
Collecting these samples should be helpful to him.
May I trouble you guys to do the job for me?

Our colleagues in the lab need more of these samples.
I'm counting on you guys to collect some for them.

The research group made a request for these samples. They might be in frequent need of these things.
May I trouble you to collect as many of them as you can?

A research group's compatibility with their Stabilizer Loops is rather low, which makes it risky for them to enter the Field.
They need some adventurers to collect some experimental samples for them.

This area boasts a high Elementium concentration, and its stability suggests collection tasks are feasible in the area.
I'd appreciate it if you guys could go there to confirm it and collect some samples while you're at it.
If there's no other problem, we'll be able to go there to collect things on a regular basis!

There's a place nearby where resources are abundant.
But we still need to collect some samples before we can be sure.
I've noticed that you happen to be in the Field, and I'd appreciate it if you could do the job for me!

It's said that the resources in that area will multiply when spatial overlapping occurs.
According to the report, this phenomenon only happens in certain areas.
Well, that's why I'm counting on you adventurers to check out the lay of the land for me!

The surveyors have discovered yet another new Collection Site nearby.
Please go scout out the lay of the land and see if there are any new resources in that place.
I have more faith in you guys than I do in anybody else. Go for it!

一支探索队遇上灰物了，好像处理起来有点麻烦。
刚好你们在附近，嘿嘿……
被我逮到了，就顺路去帮个忙吧？

灰物不知道从哪里冒出来了，之前是藏在奶油里吗？
……后面还会有技术员走这条路，
方便的话就麻烦你们进行援助啦！

啊——这附近聚集了好多灰物，它们不会也想开茶会吧？
不行，不能让它们霸占蛋糕！
请代表蛋糕消灭它们吧——

据说这个坐标附近很不稳定，灰物好像要发生异化了。
难道是因为魔女的魔法？
咳！总之……就交给你们了！

最近研究部在F10发现了很多独特的灰物，
模样大致和甜点有些相似。
我们计划研究一下它们的特性，请有经验的探索小队前往收集数据。

这片区域的氤元素读数很高，可能和灰物的活跃程度有关。
有时间的话，麻烦各位去处理一下，
别忘了顺便记录战斗报告，以备后续研究。

研究部猜测，这些灰物长时间待在F10内，
自身的结构也会随着空间的环境发生变化。
收集一些战斗数据的话，也许能更深入地理解这种现象。

最近的观测数据显示，附近有只灰物即将发生异化。
我想确认异化过程，所以战斗就交给你们了。

技术员在F10新设置了几处区域装置，
结果好像被喜欢甜食的灰物盯上了。
麻烦你们去援助一下他们吧。

在区域装置周围检测到了异常的信号，
是食物变质……？不对！好像是有灰物聚集过来了！
得靠你们了，注意安全！

这块装置发生了故障，技术员正在调试。
调试过程中突然吸引来了大量灰物……
还好有你们在，这次也拜托你们了！

刚刚接到消息，有只异化灰物正在靠近区域装置。
是把装置当成糖果了吗？明明旁边还有很多啊？
看来得在路上提前阻止它了……

为了研究F10内的环境，需要进行对照实验。
部长选择了草莓……似乎是她最喜欢的水果。
不好意思，可能要麻烦你们采集很多……

有研究员发现，F10内的果冻具有很强的弹性，
不知道布丁是不是这样……
可以拜托你们去采集一些布丁吗？

F10内的冰淇淋会一直保持在刚开始融化的状态，
为了研究这种状态，想请你们要多采集一些。
采集时请小心灰物，还要注意保持冰淇淋的形状才行……

最近有研究员在尝试烤棉花糖，
他们说，想做一个测试F10内物质的耐热试验……
可以麻烦你们去采集一些棉花糖吗？

我们的员工前几天刚补了一批材料，
结果不小心掉进了牛奶里……
真不走运——你们采集的时候也注意点啊！

最近储备的材料总是莫名其妙就没了，
估计不是陷进了奶油，就是陷进了果酱里，
挖出来也没法用，只能麻烦你们多采集点了。

最近研究部老是给我们派一些奇怪的任务，
真不知道他们是在做实验还是在做蛋糕……
什么，你们也是？没办法——一起加油干吧！

之前也发生过资源部的材料陷进奶油里的情况，
挖出来太麻烦，这次还会破坏探索路线……
看来又得麻烦你们采集了，好好干啊！

Uh, the assignment says some kind of monster popped up near a certain device, startling my colleagues.
I wonder if it's some kind of "Christmas surprise"… Um… I don't quite want it.
Do you guys think maybe you could handle it for me? I'm counting on you.

The report says some monsters around here suddenly mutated… Does that mean they became evil?
This Christmas crystal ball is sooooo cute. If a scary Ashen Creature pops up when the visitors are having fun in here, the intended pleasant surprise will become a horror!
To protect such a festive place, I'm counting on you guys to handle the situation.

The Skycart was surrounded by a large group of Ashen Creatures. I'm trying to deliver the supplies with my bare hands.
I'm not Santa… but the materials supposed to be delivered must be delivered.
I'm counting on you guys to clear the way. Go for it!

It's you guys again. I'm delivering supplies. I'm afraid I'll have to trouble you guys to dispose of the Ashen Creatures for me again.
I've made so many deliveries lately that the youngsters are referring to me as Santa in private…
Never mind. Let them be.

The researcher was heartbroken and dissolved into tears when he learned that there's no Santa Claus in F25.
If only I could offer him a gift to cheer him up…
By the way, I can give him some of the experimental materials he needs. May I trouble you guys to collect some for me?

A researcher said he wanted to celebrate Christmas in F25.
To bring him back to his senses, his colleagues meant to offer him a gift.
They say work is itself a gift… I'm afraid I need to trouble you guys to collect some research samples for me.

If only Ashen Creatures celebrated festivals and took vacations as well…
Well, maybe they're celebrating a festival right now, which is why they took apart our device.
Please dispose of them before we start the repair work.

There are few people working around here now, so we plan to do some maintenance on the devices we usually use.
I'd appreciate it if you could dispose of the Ashen Creatures nearby.

Several researchers want a research sample as a keepsake…
They've prepared some gifts for members of the Exploration Department, and they've put the gifts in position already.
Would you like to… exchange gifts with them?

Some letters of Christmas greetings went missing.
The observers discovered that they're in the Fields…
I'd appreciate it if you guys could retrieve those letters.

Yikes! There's something strange over there. Let me take a closer look… It's an Ashen Creature!
So this is what they call an Ashen Creature! Ashen Creatures are monsters. I'll keep that in mind.
The assignment says this Ashen Creature came out of nowhere and needs to be eliminated. Well then, I'll eliminate it.

Huh? The Ashen Creatures are eating the hot pot! Eek? Are they really eating it? Uh, looks like they are.
But I heard the food in here is different from the food we usually eat…
Is it not edible? Well then, I should stop them from eating more of it.

The text says the Ashen Creatures in this area are more active than usual. I think they were attracted here by the aroma of the hot pot… Or were they?
Aw, I'm not sure, but if I were an Ashen Creature, I would want to have a dinner party here with my friends as well.
The thought of that kind of gives me an appetite for hot pot… Um, let me just dispose of them first.

In video games, my characters can level up by defeating monsters that have randomly spawned along the route.
But things seem to work differently in Fields… Then why on earth should I fight them in here?
Still, I'll be rewarded when I complete my assignment, just like my character will in a video game, right?

We got a device to repair, but some Ashen Creatures suddenly popped up.
I'll tell the technicians responsible for the repair work to wait a little while longer. Please handle the Ashen Creatures for us, guys!

Maybe working in F20 tends to make people feel hungry…
A couple of my colleagues actually started eating hot pot in the Field, and it drew some Ashen Creatures to them.
I'm sorry, but I need you guys to rescue them! I'll treat you to hot pot another time!

Lately, a lot of gluttonous Ashen Creatures have turned up.
Some of them were not content with eating all our materials and actually started gnawing on the nearby devices!
The more they eat, the more likely they'll mutate. You must watch your back when you're in there!

This place requires much more frequent technical maintenance than other Fields do.
I'll mark the devices that need maintenance in the next few days.
You may clear the area beforehand if you can spare the time. It'll save you some trouble.
Ashen Creatures at the Collection Site [01]

A group of Ashen Creatures intruded into a Collection Site.
We need some adventurers to dispose of them all before they ruin the research samples.
Make some arrangements and get it done asap.
Ashen Creatures at the Collection Site [02]

The Collection Sites in this Field can easily attract Ashen Creatures.
Maybe this is also a topic worth looking into…
But before we start our research, we need you guys to get rid of those troublesome Ashen Creatures.
Ashen Creatures at the Collection Site [03]

Those Ashen Creatures popped up on the Collection Site, interfering with our research.
Therefore, we started researching the Ashen Creatures.
Please fight them as before. We'll collect the data we need during your combat.
Ashen Creatures at the Collection Site [04]

The Ashen Creatures around here are quite worth researching, just like the stuff we've been collecting is.
The disposal of Ashen Creatures will enable us to collect data and secure the Collection Site.
I hope you guys will complete this commission asap, killing two birds with one stone.

Lately, Skycarts loaded with materials can easily get attacked by Ashen Creatures.
There are two Skycarts in this area. There will be trouble if they get besieged by Ashen Creatures.
Dispose of them if you guys happen to be heading the same way!

Those Ashen Creatures closed in on it the moment I loaded it with materials.
Did they take my Skycart for a serving cart?
They leave me no choice… I'm counting on you guys to dispose of those things!

Those Ashen Creatures popped up immediately after I started loading materials into the Skycart.
Right now, they're sabotaging the door of the Skycart.
Please eliminate them. The sooner, the better!

An Ashen Creature dashed against the Skycart that was being loaded up with materials.
It struck me as a Mutated Ashen Creature, and it damaged the door of the Skycart.
Grab as many resources as you can before you go there, and be careful!

Materials found in F20 are said to be very delicious.
A colleague of mine would very much like to study them…
May I trouble you guys to go and collect some?

The researchers found that many Ashen Creatures were eating experimental materials.
To figure out the reason, please collect as many samples as you can for them.

In order to observe F20 from all angles, the researchers decided to cook a hot pot…
No, they decided to produce a similar model, to be precise.
Sorry… I'll have to trouble you guys to collect some materials for me again.

Lately, several research groups have started conducting experiments that entail heating materials.
I'm afraid I'll have to trouble you guys to collect as many materials as you can.

A researcher put up this task.
She said a type of red experimental material contaminated the white half of the Field.
She wants some adventurers to collect the materials for her.

Due to a recent data deviation, some materials of the white half of the Field have ended up in the red half.
Two research groups are arguing hotly because of it.
Putting the materials back where they belong might settle the dispute between the groups…

Some materials of the red half of the Field have ended up in the white half due to a deviation.
A researcher seems to be in distress after finding out about it…
Would you please put the materials back where they belong so that the researcher won't venture into the Field?

Several research groups are arguing about where to put the materials.
Some believe they should be put into the white half of the Field; others prefer the red half…
So far, they haven't reached an agreement yet. May I trouble you to retrieve those materials?

To build a device in this area, we need some materials.
Collecting them from the Field seems to be an easier way.
The Collection Site is right here. I'm counting on you guys to bring me the materials!

Originally, we prepared some repair materials.
But those Ashen Creatures actually ate them!
Bad luck… I'll have to trouble you guys to collect materials for me again.

Our technicians were ready to come in for the repair work.
But our repair materials suddenly went missing…
Still, there's no rush. I'll wait until you've collected enough materials before I tell them to get started!

We hoarded a whole lot of materials beside this device.
But now they're all gone, presumably eaten by Ashen Creatures.
If you guys are heading the same way, may I trouble you to collect some for me?

Notice/Rota Garden Plaza Hygiene Month

From next month starts a Plaza Hygiene Month, which is a regular environmental protection event agreed upon by all proprietors whose business premises are on the square. All residents are encouraged to participate.

Throughout June, we will be striving for better sanitation with other commercial tenants. Things we can do include but are not limited to: clean up trash, clear weeds, dispose of unwanted insects, remove unknown objects, pick up hazardous items from the beach, etc.

As there might be objects of external origins that have ended up on the square due to experiments of our company and influence of the Fields, it is hoped that adventurers with Stabilizer Loops will pitch in with the environmental protection work. Thank you very much!

The owner of Lyrical Outfits, a clothing store providing personalized service on the square, has sent us an invitation, saying that every Rota employee is welcome to contribute garment patterns to his store. Staff members interested in it may send messages with images to the Commerce Department, who will then relay them to the clothing store. You may also head to the clothing store and communicate with the store owner face-to-face.

Should you be interested in design or have any dream garments you'd like to make, please feel free to visit Lyrical Outfits clothing store outside Rota Corporation in the corner of the square. Richard the famous fashion designer will improve your patterns with proper tailoring and put the manufactured garments on sale in his store. Confide your dreams to me and I'll make them come true. The designers will also be enjoying our considerate services such as clothes altering, size customization, etc. Lyrical Outfits aims to satisfy every client's need for fashionable clothing. We promise—you won't be disappointed.

The first meeting on the pre-acceptance check of the self-developed apparatus is scheduled to begin at 15:00 tomorrow afternoon. The meeting will mainly focus on discussion about how the water storage device developed by the Technology and Research Departments work as well as the upcoming check and acceptance work. The water storage device can fully integrate with the environment of F11, allowing liquid to flow in the Field through pipe-like containers, which is beneficial to overall adjustment of the stability of F11. To make sure everything goes smoothly with our subsequent work, the following staff members are required to attend the meeting on time.

A lecture on the research on new energy by Rota Future Tech Co. has been scheduled to start at 17:00 on May 20th, 2024. In the municipal exhibition hall, the lecturer will share information about some research projects of Rota Future Tech Co. Everybody is welcome to attend the lecture.

Completion Report of Research and Development of a Mock Field

Synopsis:

The research and development work of the simulated Over Field devised for tests of new stabilizers and adventurers at the request of the Exploration and Technology Departments has been completed. The Field boasts the following features of Over Field:

Openness—it can be observed under simple conditions and has fairly low entry requirements. We plan to position the mock Field somewhere near our company, where observation can be conducted. It'll help all staff members better understand the nature of our work.

Stability—the size and curvature values of the mock Field were scaled down from those of a confirmed Field. We've positioned some regular stabilizers in the vicinity of the Field to make it more suitable for novice adventurers whose stability is still fluctuating.

Randomness—the Technology Department, when configuring the project, also drew inspiration from the original Over Field, randomizing its contents between certain coordinates. Therefore, the sizes of the scenes and items were randomized within given ranges.

The completed Field will be tested in the next few days. This is a report on the completion of the Simulated Field code-named "Test F".

PS: staff members who participated in the research and development work prefer the items in the scenes to be relaxing, hoping that it'll help alleviate testees' mental strain. Please follow this standard in subsequent maintenance and updates.

A Report on Phased Research on Stein Crystal (Summarized in 1987)

Stein Crystal is a compound found in Over Field by a scientist named Shelley Rota. "Elementium" (EIN), a reactive and unstable element, can generate a structurally stable compound through certain chemical reactions. This kind of structure can form a type of annular crystal on the outermost layer of EIN, hence the name. We call it Stein Crystal for short during our research.

Through our observations in recent years, we discovered that most items in Over Field are made up of Elementium, despite their different appearances. But even so, there are still large quantities of Stein Crystal deposits scattered throughout the Field.

It is presumably because different parts of the Field have different Elementium concentrations, causing some Elementium to crystallize. The form of Elementium varies with Field stability. It can exist in gas state, liquid state, as small particles suspended in the air, or as chunks of crystal ore.

For some unknown reason, Stein Crystal can be suspended in mid-air, and it has distinctive contours, which is why some suspect that it's a type of solid gas. Research on it is still ongoing. In addition, this kind of gaseous crystal ore assumes grotesque appearances due to environmental differences between the Fields.

A Report on Phased Research on Ashen Creatures (Summarized in 1999)

Currently, all abnormal non-microscopic organisms existing in Over Field are collectively called "Ashen Creatures".

Previously, adventurers reported sightings of Ashen Creatures of all descriptions. Some of them looked like humans or animals, and some looked like natural elements or even man-made objects, but they all had certain biological traits. They all possessed certain levels of consciousness and aggression. And when approached by creatures of external origins (e.g., our adventurers), they would instinctively launch an attack.

One thing we are sure of is that most Ashen Creatures contain Steinium and can even volatilize Crystalloid Dust. They're in an extremely unstable state in Over Field, like some kind of polymer made up of Crystalloid Dust, which is why they're called dust creatures or Ashen Creatures.

As we are currently incapable of capturing Ashen Creatures and haven't been able to capture any footage of how those creatures complete their transformation from unobserved Crystalloid Dust into observable Ashen Creatures, we still need to delve deeper into the research on Ashen Creatures in a more professional fashion.

F11 Confirmation Report

Synopsis:

I detected a change in Field stability of F2 in the observational data of Jan. 8th, 1989. After 9 months' observation and data recording, I confirmed the existence of an unreported new Field with the same curvature as that of F2. In accordance with the existing numbers in the database, it was given the interim name of Field No. 11, aka Field 11. A detailed description of this matter was included in the discovery report submitted on that day (Oct. 13th, 1989). (Official Report Document ST2-8910 016 011)

Over the past year I've verified that F11 is a Field suitable for observation and capable of stable unwrapping, one that our company has been searching for. As the Field is currently inaccessible to us, we can only confirm the existence of Steinium by dint of Luik. This September, with the help of the Technology Department, I successfully collected 2 oz (56.7g) of Stein Crystal, which shows that the resources in F11 are highly compatible with the technologies we currently possess.

Therefore, I submitted this report to the department, confirming F11 as an explorable Field.

Completion Report of the First Preliminary Exploration of F11

Synopsis:

The team conducting this preliminary exploration of F11 is comprised of the following four members. Their adventurer numbers:
07, Rick Hoft, male, 33, Exploration Department. Team leader.
04, Bina Torna, female, 34, Resource Department.
09, Larson S Derain, 39, Exploration Department.
12, Anduals Ray, male, 26, Exploration Department.

First, I have a most regrettable incident to report. In this preliminary exploration we lost an outstanding adventurer: Larson S Derain. But I'm not suggesting he's dead. We don't know where he is or what happened to him. We searched as many areas as we could within the stipulated 70-hour time limit but still couldn't find him or any clues to his whereabouts. As the leader of the team, I made a misjudgment. I'm willing to accept any punishment meted out to me.

About the progress of the preliminary exploration, I believe Ms. Torna, who has returned to the Research Department, will submit a report much more detailed than mine. One thing I'm sure of is that we've achieved the early goals of preliminary exploration: scout the lay of the land, detection of Steinium. I hope our company will arrange the next preliminary exploration as soon as possible, preferably within a week. I'm positive Derain will still be alive by then.

Completion Report of the Second Preliminary Exploration of F11

Synopsis:

The team responsible for the second preliminary exploration of F11 comprises three members. Their adventurer numbers:
12, Anduals Ray, male, 29, Exploration Department. Applicant for the mission, team leader.
18, Gorman Linnet, male, 25, Training Department.
03, Lisa Gabella Hoft, female, 41, Logistics Department.

The purpose of this preliminary exploration is to ascertain the level of danger in F11, collect, summarize and report as much intel as possible about the denizens (unnamed) of F11: their species, aggression levels, habitats and how to eliminate them. We completed about 55% of the sleuthing within the 70-hour time limit. In the next 3 months we'll cooperate with the data department and submit a new, more detailed report. Conducting missions in groups of three is inefficient, but it guarantees safe evacuation of all members and helps them maintain a high level of combat readiness and intel integration capability. It is advisable for our company to make it compulsory for subsequent missions to be conducted this way, so that there won't be a repeat performance of the accident that happened to 09. To spy out the land in F11 and guarantee safe entry and exit for participants of subsequent missions was the initial goal our company aimed to achieve by establishing the "preliminary exploration" protocol.

Last but not least, I hope a new preliminary exploration will be arranged as soon as possible so that the rest of the mission can be completed.

Notice/Removal of Incorrect Action "Photography-Induced Disappearance of Markers"

In Fields are some "special markers". There's no way to verify whether they're images or words, or what they're meant to convey. Prior to this, adventurers always recorded special markers by drawing them, but the quality of the drawings varied greatly with adventurers' drawing skills. 

The latest device, which comes with camera features, was expected to record special markers more distinctly, but its photography feature turned out to have unknown influence on the markers. According to the adventurers, most special markers disappear seconds after being photographed.

Therefore, the Explorational Research Department re-enacted the phenomenon in a simulated Field. After 74 tests, it was verified that the chance of the phenomenon being triggered was 100%, but the special marker did not disappear. The same amount of Steinium still existed in its original position. The marker was still there. It's just that the photography changed its stability, causing it to lose its visual effect and become transparent. The Research Department calls this phenomenon a [stability deviation].

As photographing a special marker is the most accurate way to record it but will cause it to "disappear", the Exploration and Research Departments conducted a lot of discussion as to whether to continue photographing the markers.

The eventual results of the discussion: until the invention of new photographic equipment that does not cause stability deviation, adventurers are allowed moderate use of photography when recording special markers. The influence of special markers' invisibility on Fields is infinitesimal, but it's very important to our research work. Only by quickening our collection work and research will we be able to learn more about the deviation phenomenon and Over Field.

Prior to this, our company had always deemed it an issue of incorrect exploratory action. From this month onward, the stipulation will be removed from the Exploratory Code of Conduct. The updated handbooks will be issued by the end of the month.

Report/Case 10: Isle of Moon Blindfolding

Case 10, which Meta Research Center commissioned Rota Corporation to research in January, 2008, was a rather large-scale special incident.

Synopsis: The Skyroot Isle, aka "Isle of Moon", lies about 300 kilometers east of the continental shelf. After the local residents held an annual sacrificial ceremony to celebrate the New Year on Jan. 1st, multiple people suffered sudden deaths in succession between the evening and the next morning. All victims covered their eyes with their hands in pain and eventually died of mechanical asphyxia. Until the next morning when the police were informed, 10 people had been found dead and five had gone missing. The incidents caused panic among local residents. The police outside the island ruled out the possibilities of poisoning and air pollution during their investigation. Unable to draw a conclusion, they had to seek help from Meta Research Center.

Inference: After a survey of the scene, it was found that every winter the Isle of Moon underwent abnormal changes of stability and time-space curvature. The survey was conducted when the anomalies were declining, but there was still a massive overflow of Elementium. Subsequent sleuthing showed that the ceremony held yearly by local residents on New Year's Day had something to do with the moon undergoing an unusual astronomical phenomenon similar to "Oculus", so they concluded that every winter Over Field overlapped the location mentioned in the case. And it was very likely that the incident happened because some kind of virus in the Field or its Elementium concentration had a bad influence on regular people.

Conclusion: The phenomenon was caused by Over Field overlapping the real world. Skycarts invented by Rota Corporation have been positioned to collect excessive Elementium and maintain the stability of the island. More details can be found in the complete document and appendices.

Report/Case 13: Prismatic Echo

Case 13, which Meta Research Center commissioned Rota Corporation to research in December, 2013, was the location of a special phenomenon.

Synopsis: A mysterious event occurred in a recreational facility called "Prismatic House" in Fair Town. Ever since June, the proprietor of the facility had received multiple complaints about unknown voices coming from inside the Prismatic House. The police, having investigated several times without finding any potential suspects, had no choice but to advise the proprietor to close the Prismatic House as a temporary expedient. In October, a security guard hired by the proprietor, when examining the Prismatic House, could still hear outsiders' voices, but the police searched the house several times and couldn't find anything. The police sought help from Meta Research Center.

Inference: During fieldwork, our company conducted a series of tests on stability, Elementium concentration and space-time curvature. The results suggested that the location of the case had been overlapping Over Field since June, causing the house to overlap multiple other overlapped locations concurrently. The prisms dispersed the light, so there was no distinct reflection of the overlapped locations. Only the sounds were transmitted almost in full. In a sense, the Field acted as a reflective prism of sound, which was why they heard a lot of voices but didn't see anybody.

Conclusion: The phenomenon was caused by Over Field overlapping the real world. The affected area has been stabilized, and the phenomenon in the Prismatic House has disappeared. More details can be found in the complete document and appendices.

Report/Case 29: Static State

People in multiple overlapped areas felt the tremors simultaneously, with damage caused by quakes of the same magnitude. Due to the influence of the overlapping, these people experienced different temporal cognition. It had happened in some other places before.

Conclusion: The phenomenon was caused by Over Field overlapping the real world. The trace amounts of Elementium that leaked into the affected areas have been recycled. There are no ramifications. More details can be found in the complete document and appendices.

Report/Case 54: Intangible Threads

Case Subject 54 (male), whom Meta Research Center commissioned Rota Corporation to research in April, 2016, developed an abnormal cognitive disorder.

Synopsis: the subject developed a cognitive disorder after narrowly escaping death in an accident and claimed to see "threads" everywhere. The doctors of the hospital he was in believed that his retinas or vitreous bodies had been damaged, or his nerves were transmitting wrong visual signals. Afterward the subject tried to destroy those threads, only to cause multiple facilities in the ward to shatter and an orderly to get killed. The police were unable to confirm the murder from the victim's injuries. After they decided to give the subject a psychiatric evaluation, the latter died in the detention center. The police pulled the surveillance video and discovered that it had been a sudden, eerie occurrence, so they commissioned Meta Research Center to look into it.

Inference: There's a reported Field phenomenon that took place at the same time and location as the accident that the subject experienced. It's very likely that the subject was exposed to the spatial overlapping, causing his eyeballs or optic nerves to become a trigger for spatial overlapping. When he looked at an object, the triggered spatial overlapping enabled him to see the unidimensional "threads" that allowed the object to partially enter the Field, but then he destroyed the threads, causing the part of the object to be stuck in the Field, hence the severed objects and human bodies. That was the reason for their deaths.

Conclusion: The phenomenon was caused by Over Field overlapping the real world. The subject had stopped all physiological activities, no matter whether it was suicide or something else. More details can be found in the complete document and appendices.

Report of Confirmation of the Name of "Dust Creatures" in Over Field

During our multiple past explorations of F11, we received reports from many adventurers about their encounters with dangerous monsters. Synopsis: On the morning of Jun. 3rd, 2017, an online article editor called the municipal police station and claimed that the subject of Case 101 had been missing for almost a month. After looking into his blog ID, we discovered that he had rented a local apartment. His apartment was tidy and clean, with no sign of forced entry. After checking the personal letters in a locked drawer, we learned that the subject had corresponded with a Rota employee named Aliatha (realness in doubt). In the letters, the employee expressed their intention to utilize company equipment without permission and against the company's secrecy rules. Currently, the subject of Case 101 is unaccounted for. The case is still under investigation.

Inference: The person that the subject of Case 101 corresponded with was a staff member named Aliatha. We looked into it and found there was no employee named Aliatha in our company. The couple of incidents that happened in the same period are still under investigation. Relevant clues will be included in the appendix to the case report.

Conclusion: The subject of Case 101 might have gained entry into a Field with the help of the mysterious employee named Aliatha. Their actions might have affected our company somehow. The truth remains concealed.
