The Observer's Primacy (Part 1)

The sustained stability of an Over Field during an Observer's observation was a hypothesis of Mr. and Ms. Rota, later confirmed by experiments after Dr. Torna founded the corporation. Observable and stable spaces theoretically enable human entry into the Over Field (hereafter referred to as the Field). Lacking the original Rota observation methods and data, Research Department developed its own for long-term monitoring. Establishing corporate HQs, branches, and outposts at locations with anomalous stability values facilitates this sustained observation. Instruments steadily apply various interventions to the anomalous stability epicenters. Observing researchers then assess the current state of each Field based on retrieved data—that's the Rota corporation's daily observation routine.

As posited in my book, "Analyzing the Over Field Under Schrödinger's Cat Paradigm," the portion of the Field coupled with our reality collapses—determined by observation itself. This means that the observer's initiative within the Field is beyond doubt. Thus, Adventurers, in theory, could leverage this primacy to proactively determine resource viability and Dust Creature threat levels. However, theoretical only. Stabilizer limitations, inherent human "impurities", and Research Department's observation interference severely constrain the Adventurer's practical primacy.

Current R&D on Area Terminal and Fast-travel Landmark aims to prevent accidents common in the old exploration era. These man-made stabilizers can better facilitate the Adventurer's observational primacy.

The Observer's Primacy (Part 2)

With our new stabilizer (beta), severing Research Department's fixed observation confirms the Adventurer's inherent observational advantage. Through primacy, Adventurers can continuously affirm Field coordinates, resource viability, Dust Creature threat levels—even the life or death status of entities within the Field. Yet, safety isn't guaranteed. Without superior observation of both Field and Adventurer, everything becomes uncontrollable—potentially riskier than before.

Quantum entanglement offers a solution. If the Field and reality are entangled states, synchronizing two entangled quanta enables preemptive observation: retain a portion of the Adventurer's stabilizer at HQ. The corporation gains primacy, directing operations. If a crisis strikes, Rota Unwrapping severs the entanglement. Stabilizer data here then re-entangles with the Adventurer side, backtracking and resetting their state—potentially backtracking even life or death.

Building on this, Research Department and Tech Development Department propose two enhancements: 1) Create a superior observation tier—a Captain Stabilizer acting as the Main Stabilizer for the team. It performs preemptive observation, syncing data to Sub-stabilizers, providing Adventurers with consolidated intelligence. 2) Integrate a simplified state-backtracking function via Unwrapping methodology. These technologies are crucial for the new stabilizer's success.

Novelist's Diary, 2006

Every year, I return to the place where my grandfather vanished. Without realizing it, ten years have passed. I met a young man who claimed to be my grandfather's student—Mr. Fukuyama. Grandfather had taught many students in the past, but the only one I knew well was Miss Kazuko.

The business card Mr. Fukuyama handed me had the name of some kind of agency. I didn't really understand such things, nor did I care. I much preferred the legends Grandfather used to tell me. Fukuyama didn't seem bothered by my indifference. Instead, he brought up the subject he and Grandfather had studied together—Uehara Legend.

I had seen mentions of it in Grandfather's notes and books—it was said to be another world, one that did not belong to reality. Grandfather once said he had been to Uehara and longed to return. His archaeological and folkloric research had been acknowledged by many scholars, but the Uehara Legend he cherished most was always dismissed as a fabricated text.

To chase a daydream for one's entire life—is that greatness, or foolishness? I respected Grandfather deeply, yet I could not be entirely sure, because I was not him.

"Mr. Fukuyama, since you study Uehara… can you tell me if it truly exists?" I asked him.

On that face, which didn't look like it belonged to a man in his thirties, there was a smile strikingly similar to Grandfather's.

"I can vouch for my teacher—without a doubt, Miss Sakura."

Novelist's Diary, 2016

Twenty years ago, the police declared my grandfather dead. But I could never let it go. Every year I visit the countryside where he once stayed, imagining he might be somewhere in the village or up in the mountains—just like my sister…

I'm no longer the naïve child I once was.

People vanish mysteriously. Things appear where they shouldn't. Some cities fall into sudden stillness. Strange illnesses are linked to bizarre phenomena. And certain recurring "motifs" appear in the histories of many nations, demanding comparison…Culture has its unique traits and its shared elements. But if those unique traits defy reason, and those shared elements can't be explained objectively… perhaps the best way forward is to broaden how we imagine the world itself.

If the world is truly as my sister said—that some gods have covered our eyes—then it all makes sense: Uehara exists. And Grandfather exists there too.

To prove Grandfather's daydream was real, I keep writing more of my own. When each one comes true, this world will become more real, more complete.

Still, sometimes I recall that face—a face that didn't seem like it belonged to someone in his thirties.

That must have been a daydream too… one that belonged only to me.

The Purple Journal

Every time I see Miss Sakura's smile, I think of my younger sister. Though she was much younger than Sakura, their smiles were just the same.

Yet I can't help but think—if only I had truly believed the words of my ancestors back then. Cover my eyes well, do not look at the moon… Father and the Barnacle Lord were right.

As a saintess, I protected that child. But as a saintess, I failed to trust His Excellency the Sky Eye and Lord Fujimori—that's why I was banished "there"…

I am grateful to the gods for letting me meet Sakura, and for letting me save another child. At least I have not despaired over my own worth. I still bear the saintess's mission, and that is why I am "here."

So, His Excellency the Sky Eye, please tell me—where will I go next? Who else must I save? If… that is my destiny…

The Telegrapher's Exile Project - Tuscany's Preliminary Concept

Fanciful inventions in films fostered my affection for steam engines—machines that hiss and vent gas are inherently compelling.

Harnessing this for perpetual motion, however, is near impossible. Because endless steam demands endless combustion. Yet witnessing how fast humanity destroys nature, I realized no natural substance is inexhaustible. Where, then, to find air to burn?

Mrs. Rota's research offered hope—an observable Aberrant Fields, holding other possibilities.

What I intend to do is certainly not something pointless to my world like "inventing a perpetual motion machine in Aberrant Fields." Instead, I conceived a miniature "Luik Box" within the machine. One part remains perpetually within the Field, and under divergent physical laws, it interacts with the other part, thereby achieving a "perpetual" operational state.

This telegraph would serve as the prototype.

No telegraph, to my knowledge, could operate autonomously. When Mrs. Rota discussed this matter with me, it immediately occurred to me: if the armature on a telegraph can insert a pencil tip and write telegrams by itself, why can't another armature tap the key and receive telegrams autonomously?

I named it the Wanderer. To say something uncharacteristic of me: when its thin rod taps the key, it will sing a wanderer's song. Perhaps this is the finest verse I've ever written in my life.

Unfortunately, this machine is not a perpetual motion machine. Merely an automaton receiving low-frequency signals, scattering slips—enough for a thousand telegrams. I think, probably in fifty years, the machine's mobility would cease, yet it could still log telegrams until its fine paper depletes.

My gratitude to Mrs. Rota and her associate for this opportunity. May its user recall me—Tuscany, the great mechanic.

Definition of Pseudepigrapha
Compiled by the Astral Coterie

The Astral Coterie Historical Research Institute's collaboration with Rota Exploration Co. involves collating and authenticating commissioned texts. This process revealed numerous pseudepigrapha, characterized by:

1. Falsely attributed to renowned scholars or series, or bearing fabricated author names.

2. Contain anachronistic descriptions, terminology, or unverifiable accounts.

3. Potential promotion or guidance of relatively modern ideologies. (Non-essential criterion)

Texts meeting these criteria were identified. After deliberation, the following are defined as pseudepigrapha:

We Discuss the Motif
Refutation of the Consequentialism of Motif
From Eastern Pyramids to Western Deluge

These three books were attributed to Hawsam Hermet. Hermet, a 15th-century cultural scholar, focused on the folk mythos "Artor Problem". "Motif", as a folkloric concept, emerged much later—alien to 15th-century scholarship. Since the books discuss the Goddess Artor from Artor Problem, it is likely for this reason that they were falsely attributed to Hermet. Hermet's descendants excluded these texts from his compiled works. Thus, we define these three books as pseudepigrapha. Furthermore, The Hermet Poems was not included in the collected works; however, based on textual research, the poetry collection is believed to be written by Hermet himself.

The First Contact

The weather was consistently hot after we entered the target waters. Before beginning the search and rescue, the captain decided to form an advance team for the first operation. I wanted to go too, but the team leader told me to stay on the ship and wait. My senior did the same—he said I had no experience and should just stay put on the ship. His words were frustrating, but I had to admit it was true.

Not long after the rescue advance team set off, a massive storm hit the sea, covering hundreds of kilometers and causing the temperature to drop by at least 20 degrees. If I had to describe the situation, I could only compare it to my first time at a shooting range—it felt like I was the only one in the world who was nervous.

The captain told us to return to the cabin, but I decided to wait a little longer on the deck. Finally, I saw the advance team's rescue boat. They were heading our way. The rescue boat was semi-enclosed and not easily capsized, but it still couldn't withstand the storm and was flipped over.

Everyone but the team leader swam up, shivering from the cold. The rescue team members said that he had saved us. But my senior remained silent. I made him a hot cup of black coffee, then remembered he didn't like bitter drinks and rushed to get some sugar, but by the time I got back, the coffee was gone.

After that, my senior stayed locked in his room until about a quarter past seven. He suddenly came out and told us the radar had a signal—the ship had traveled from the tropics to the Arctic. Fortunately, there was an Arctic station nearby, and he had found its coordinates.

Everyone was astonished, because the ship couldn't have traveled that far in half a day, and we had been in the storm the whole time, not sailing in a straight line in any direction. Some crew members expressed their displeasure, but my senior just smiled and told them that if they didn't get to the Arctic station soon, their ship would likely be frozen in place, and they would have to walk there.

The next morning, the ship was indeed frozen, and the storm had passed. The captain decided to follow my senior's advice—to walk across the ice. Before we set off, my senior said: "The Leader fulfilled his duty." But even I could tell that not everyone on the ship was ordinary. Most were trained mercenaries, and secrets lurked among them.

We walked across the ice to the Arctic station. It was the most difficult and bizarre journey I had ever taken. There are even fish frozen in the ice due to the sudden drop in temperature. After a 23-kilometer walk, staff from the Arctic station found us. They introduced themselves as researchers from a certain company. When we described our strange and terrifying experience, they didn't seem surprised at all, as if they had been through similar things many times—this was our first contact with them.

Descendants of the Hermet family also periodically traveled back and forth during their academic careers for scholarly research. Boundaries of Life - Aberrants
By N. Abbas

That red crystal—the Fifth Element, the Red Elixir, or as they called it then, the "Philosopher's Stone"—was the source of all dreams of immortality.

Immortality was the dream of all alchemists in the Middle Ages, and the Abbas Family was no exception. Obsessed with elixirs and alchemy, they confined everyone within that ancient castle, attempting day after day to achieve it. During an exceptionally serendipitous experiment, they obtained a certain red crystal. This wondrous element reacted with neither metal nor liquid. Only environmental changes—such as intense heat or light—could affect it, causing it to emit a radiant glow. Thus, the Abbas Family conceived an idea: could it react with living beings? This required experimentation.

The experiment involved: selecting several animal species and human volunteers to enter a chamber sequentially. Using the red stone as the base material, processes like burning and boiling were applied to it while observing any changes in the subjects. When the crystal glowed, it generated a luminous film that enveloped the living subject. Then, the miraculous occurred: some subjects vanished, while others lost their original forms, becoming grotesque yet unstable. Fearful of the danger, the experimenters halted the test. The Castle Legend

The ancient castle, hidden deep within the mist-covered mountains, is now over a thousand years old. The castle's northwest turret was destroyed in a wildfire last year. In the center of the room was an altar covered in dense, insect-like patterns. We didn't dare approach it. Around the altar, there are stacks of books lying about. Besides messy ancient script and mathematical formulas, there are also symbols that look like eyes. I couldn't help but copy down the text and symbols until my flashlight's battery was almost dead. Just then, something on the altar emitted a red light, but when I looked at it, I only saw pitch black…

Once, there were two families of noble blood, destined to be joined in marriage to continue their sacred lineage. In this generation, a gentleman and a lady were also fated to do the same. After reading him, I found him fascinating—and profoundly pitiable. To doubt and scorn all things—is to dwell in solitude's sharp pain. I think I glimpsed his voids as well.

Yigonal - Endless Wait
By Yuri Reed

About a week after the disaster, I mailed my final letter and waited, as agreed, in the corner bookstore. From five till near nine—four hours—I sat in the corner, thumbing a worn novel. No cause for haste. I sensed answers within the pages—yet I couldn't focus. Or dared not.

Around nine, a young couple entered. Spotting Yigonal's books—prominently displayed under the fire's grim guise—they whispered, thinking themselves alone: "The arson case… It was said that five or six had slipped in that night… only Miss Yigonal inside… poor girl… died in her sleep."

I'd long known certain groups reviled Yigonal's writings—deeming him a vile enemy. I'd tried to placate them with words. Not enough. Far from it.

On that frigid winter night, Leah Yigonal mailed her last letter to me and went to sleep early. Perhaps she planned her next piece—how to strike at superstition and injustice, how to animate the brother who never was. But she lay there, and woke no more.

《空间记录1997附录-白色湮灭》
灵会 编纂

6月，白草原发生了一起神秘的现象级事件，白色草原接近3千平方米的区域整个消失。并非只是地面的草地消失，而是包括地下三十米左右的深度也一并消失了。由于罗塔科技在白草原有定期观测，这一现象恰好被附近的装置观测到，发现了一个从未遇到过的数值变化：消失的空洞大约为球形，以白草原某个点为中心，半径约三十米。包括地面上的空间在某个时间瞬时达到了接近空间水平的氤元素浓度，但在超过空间稳定状态该有的极限值后却又很快降为零。这一数值表现近似于眼现象发生时的数值，不同的是，眼现象即使消失，仍然会有一部分元素进入缓慢的衰减期，逐渐转化为普通物质。而这一事件大不相同，这个球形范围内没有检测到任何元素，氧气也不存在，并且周围没有人目击到任何类似眼的异常现象发生。

托尔纳博士判断，这有可能是一起类似物质碰撞造成的“湮灭”，即空间与现实进行了对消灭。此前在历年记录与各地观测中从未遇到过这样的情况，这是我们第一次发现“湮灭”现象，并将此事命名“白色湮灭”事件。

补充资料：白草原在过去也有过神秘事件，曾有流星落到这里使整片草原发生了大面积白化。白化指植物的所有部位都变成了白色，但根据检测，叶绿体仍可进行光合作用产生色素，只是这种色素显现的颜色无法被肉眼观测。此外，在白化的植物中发现了一些混乱的基因片段，包含有星兜、鼠尾草、三叶草、大戟、玫瑰、鸢尾、酸浆。其中星兜、三叶草、大戟、玫瑰是白草原原生植物，另一些则在此地从未发现过。这种现象很可能与空间有关，因此开始定期观测。

We were concerned about the working environment within the Field. As a result, we did not provide the now-stable F20 to other departments for some time.

According to the Adventurers' descriptions, F07 is at room temperature, while F11 feels like the late spring climate. The sensation of warmth when the sun shines resembles that of a spring day. However, actual data showed no subtle changes in the Adventurer's body temperature, though the amount of elements they were exposed to fluctuated, indicating a change in information.

Theoretically, we believe that the physical concept of "temperature" does not exist in Over Field. The perceived temperature is simply a "simulated" experience retained by the elements during their synchronization with the real world. Once these elements are converted into information, the Adventurer experiences a subjective sensation of temperature. However, whether this "simulation" originates from the Adventurer's own subjectivity or from the observational position needs to be tested in practice.

We first conducted tests using a drone equipped with a thermal imager and thermochromic materials. After the observation team ate hot pot, they then performed a subjective observation of F20. Visually, the Field appeared to "boil" or show "no steam" based on observer's cognition. However, the drone's actual measurements showed no temperature change. The subsequent tests with the Adventurers yielded the same results: it was merely the information transmission that generated the "simulated" sensation. After adjusting the environmental data of the stabilizer loop, this "simulated" feeling disappeared.

Spatial Overlapping or New Discoveries

By Shershol Holme

What we usually refer to as "overlapping" means the conceptual convergence between the place we occupy (the "real world") and the Over Field. In these overlapping areas, material elements undergo a restructuring of Elementium, much like how materials in the real world are reassembled into similar forms. More precisely, Elementium is a fundamental particle.

Colloquial terms like "element replacement" or "matter transfer" used to describe observations after Elementium disentanglement are not entirely accurate. To be precise, the overlap causes matter and Elementium particles to become entangled in sync. Due to space-time curvature, observation is only possible from one side (the Field side), causing the matter to appear as if it has "vanished" on the other side (the real world side). Before this, we hadn't noticed why a location—physically defined as a mixture of various materials—could remain observable on both sides post-overlap?

If one-sided observation is a certainty—that the matter of these locations is observed from one side in our real world—then why would the Field contain scenery similar to theirs? Perhaps we should think beyond Field and consider the concept of time. If the overlap also involves time, such that a real-world location at a certain moment (for example, the past, a second ago) overlaps with the Field, what we are seeing could be that location at "another point in time" (for instance, now, this very second)… Could this be the explanation?

In the past, we often stated Fields lack temporal concepts—but this referred to the observed state. The real Field must continue to evolve outside our observation; otherwise, we wouldn't be able to explain how certain small, unobserved Fields form.

Yet each region of Chumway interprets the Sixgold uniquely, so the Draconic Immortal resolved to tour the six Gods' homelands, tasting every variation across Chumway—That's the beginning of Draconic Immortal's Gastronomic Pilgrimage.

Prayer for Azure Skies

Kingdom X fell under invasion, outmatched in strength, retreating in defeat again and again. General Lance Lee, hailed as the Azure General, covered the allies' retreat. But his lone force was crushed, and he died near the city's moat. His body drifted downstream to the river's far shore.

Elowen Immortal of Elysian Isle found him and bore him to the immortal realm. Through Elowen Immortal's healing, the General revived and convalesced in Elysian Isle. As his wounds healed, General Lee yearned to go back to fight for his kingdom. Elowen Immortal questioned, deeming mortal wars mere conflicts of desire—unworthy of sacrifice. But the General declared: "I fight to end all wars." He sought to defend borders with overwhelming might, deterring invaders for lasting peace.

Elowen Immortal witnessed war's ravages upon the people, was moved by his resolve, and decided to leave Elysian Isle for Kingdom X. By then, the situation had tilted overwhelmingly, Kingdom X was on the verge of destruction. However, with Elowen Immortal's omniscient wisdom and trust, the General won victory after victory. Finally, he pushed kingdom borders to their original line, signing an armistice.

When peace dawned, love blossomed between the two. But immortality and mortality diverge. After accompanying the General to life's end, Elowen Immortal returned to Elysian Isle. Touched by their devotion, the people enshrined their statues. Thus their tale endures through ages. Now a woman stands before the temple statues, remembering their legend.

The Spiciest Hot Pot—Who Dares to Challenge?

Gough Hot Pot Restaurant has become the city's most famous hot pot joint. Since its opening, Chumway Hot Pot was only a local favorite, but Gough Hot Pot has taken the city by storm, with over ten new Chumway Hot Pot restaurants opening this year. Just when we thought Gough Hot Pot's popularity would die down, they introduced something new—the Hellfire Spicy Combo.

This fiery hot pot set claims to be the hottest in history, and if you dare to order it, the broth is on the house. This bold advertising quickly attracted a crowd, especially among spice lovers who declared they'd suffer through it—because that's how red-hot they want their food to be!

Within a week of its launch, the Hellishly Spicy Combo went viral, with numerous food bloggers sharing their spicy challenges on Nutjob. Comments like "It's so hot, but I'll eat it again!" flooded the platform, showing just how much spice-loving youth are craving hotter and hotter food these days. Thanks to this fiery new challenge, Chumway Hot Pot has once again become the go-to choice for spicy food lovers. If you can't handle the Hellishly Spicy Combo, don't worry—Chumway's famous Double-Flavor Hot Pot will still be waiting for you.

Everyone agreed that Chumway Hot Pot is still Gough's signature spicy pot, but this set menu cranks the heat up even more! For true chili daredevils, this is one fiery challenge you can't afford to miss!

Moonfeast Delicacies—Experience the Flavors of Chumway

"Experience the flavors of Chumway, savoring traditional culture," the Chumway Moonfeast Festival went viral on Nutjob this September.

On Moonaroma Street, you'll find everything from coconut desserts and juicy fried dumplings to sweet-and-sour skewers and the signature Chumway Old Hot Pot. Walk where you will, eat what you like—this feast stretches like a dragon through the streets. Every shop has its own unique cuisine. Street cart dishes are so photogenic that a random picture is a perfect food shot. This has attracted many food bloggers, and scrolling through a photo online feels as if you can smell the aroma through your phone.

Chumway has become a city "marinated" in its own flavors. Wherever you go, the air is filled with the tantalizing aroma of food. This brings us to the Chumway's revered deity—Draconic Immortal.

An ancient legend goes that whenever a lunar eclipse occurs, the shape of a dragon emerges in the sky, and the people of Chumway are blessed with the aroma of delicious food. During times of famine or disaster, people still feel full from the scent alone, a gift said to come from the Draconic Immortal using the moon's divine energy to nourish them. From then on, the tradition of worshiping the lunar eclipse, the dragon, and food has been preserved to this day, leading to the Grand Dragon Feast on Moonaroma Street and the customs of the Moonfeast Festival.

Reunion in the Pot

Hot pot, one of the oldest and most primal cooking methods, has stood the test of time. People gather around, cooking simple ingredients in the pot—no complicated techniques required. With just the combination of fire and water, it evokes a unique sense of warmth. This "cooking" act not only provides an easy way to share delicious food, but it also symbolizes a universal human desire: reunion.

For centuries, hot pot has been more than just a meal; it has come to represent emotion and togetherness. From snowy fields to rainy alleyways, the steam from a hot pot has always bridged the gap between people. Evolving through society, this simple custom became a banquet staple worldwide, every flavor bearing local customs and family lore.

The reason hot pot endures is that the emotions it represents never go out of style. In the simmering pot, broth bubbles alongside the joy of reunion and hearthside intimacy. Whether with family, friends, or even strangers, anyone can become a partner in enjoying a hot pot meal. While the flavor of the food may change over time, the warmth that comes from shared moments of togetherness will never fade.

Demoness Conquers Another World 2

Rhea has now been in this other world for a month, and it feels like an endless RPG with new NPCs bringing new quests.

"The Death Village has been redeemed by you, my respected Demoness. And from now on, it is your autonomous territory." The Goddess Church entrusted her with a village. But she knows reviving a post-plague village wouldn't be easy. Luckily, Rhea's simulation game tactics once revived a village. She plans to apply that experience here. But this time, the challenges seem different.

Agrarian reform, legal regulations, attracting investment, infrastructure, education, healthcare… each issue seemed to overwhelm everyone. Soon, confusion, discontent, and anger started brewing…

---"To unite them… make them understand the concept of collective will… I know! Hold a celebration! My inauguration!"

The first step in her strategy sim is? An oath ceremony?! The "Entrepreneurial Demoness Achieves Godhood" spin-off series, "Demoness Conquers Another World": The Startup chapter—Commence Strategy!

I always wanted to go to Chumway for an investigation but never got to go, so I thought I'd treat myself to some hot pot. Guess what—two days before yesterday I worked overtime, yesterday overtime, and the day before that too… A whole week, every time I get off work, the hot pot shop is closed!

Today I finally got off early, finished all reports, and reserved a table at the most popular hot pot restaurant in the city. Finally, I could eat hot pot! But guess what—BIG EYE's out again—Yet again, I've drawn the short straw and been assigned to the overnight team for the local mission!

WHY ME AGAIN! WHY the BIG EYE come out again?! Do you have any idea how hard is is to get a reservation for Gough Hot Pot Restaurant?! Aaaaah… Oh? The place I'm being dispatched to is Chumway?! Oh, never mind then, hehe…

Lost Diary

I smelled a scent from childhood—like boiling water with radish, cabbage, chili peppers, and round mushrooms… I thought, that must be the smell of home.

Following the smell, the town disappeared, rooftops turned into cabbage leaves, and the lotus pond bubbled—This place is so strange, I must be lost.

But I still remember that smell. I left home too young to remember the people, but I remember the smell. Maybe the cook is from my hometown, or maybe not. Maybe my hometown's flavors have spread far and wide…

If I keep going, can I get back? There are so many roads— which one leads to where I want? Where do I want to go?

I lower my head, unable to find my way. And then, the smell left me.

Grandfather's teahouse isn't big, it only has two floors. The second floor has always been small. Some rooms are always locked; only two private rooms can fit tables. From what I remember, only Grandpa's longtime friends ever went upstairs. Later, fewer elders came. After Grandpa passed, fewer customers came to the ground floor, and the second floor wasn't needed anymore. My parents said that teahouses were no longer in vogue, and they planned to sell the shop to someone else. It's sad—it's my grandpa's, my great-grandpa's, passed down through generations. But my parents are ordinary teachers, not businesspeople.

I still remember the day the teahouse was emptied. Those locked rooms had to be dealt with, and the elders were curious about these doors that had never been opened, just like I was. I don't know if the locks aged or the keys were wrong, the doors never opened. So somehow, the small building was never sold. After a few tries, relatives advised my parents to give up and convert the place into rental rooms. I watched them plan renovations—the plans showed no trace of Grandpa's teahouse anymore.

Later, I took over the small teahouse. From knowing nothing about tea, I roughly read Grandpa's tea books and learned a bit. The unpopular teahouse certainly didn't have many customers. I had to run the tea business while learning from other teahouses to add meals—turning it into a small diner.

Those locked rooms still remain unopened. Sometimes I think maybe Grandpa and his old friends are upstairs, sipping tea and watching me from above. I try to talk like Grandpa, hoping to make them laugh—just like when I was a kid.

Record of the Floating Tea Vol.1

In half a cup of floating tea, one beholds the flavor of life.

The teahouse is a self-contained cosmos aloof from worldly clamor, yet embracing all walks of life. I oft sit by the window, observing patrons through fragrant vapors: nobles and generals, peddlers and porters, young and old, joyous and sorrowful—all with life experiences lingering in the shadow of their eyelashes.

One cup of tea conceals all flavors of existence. Newly steeped tea assaults with bitterness, yet reveals a sweet aftertaste upon savoring. This duality of bitter-sweet—only the sipper grasps its truth. Though bitterness may overwhelm sweetness, while warmth remains, some still like holding the cup—savoring life's brew, awaiting the return of sweetness.

Thus I record those witnessed through years, tales heard, truths perceived, compiled as this Record of the Floating Tea. Life, like tea, unfolds within measured steepings, yet floating leaves converge the flavor of life, stirring eternal remembrance.

Southern Tales I: A Serendipitous Meeting

That family's girl never cared for rules. Even when she was little, the adults in her family would look at her dismantled toys and agree that nothing could ever hold her down.

She was born in a small village in the south. The sky was pale blue, the waters a deep jade green, and the roadside trees formed green canopies. Everything was peaceful and beautiful, yet nothing she loved was there. She loved red—the fiery crimson, bright and intense, like the newly risen sun, radiant and beautiful.

One day, red arrived in her village. It was a Lion Dance Troupe—a splash of red paint on a black-and-white ink landscape—that brought a splash of bright crimson to her memories. Restless by nature, when the troupe performed in her village, she went straight to the leader and begged to join them, to see the sights of different places, and to spread that blazing red further.

The troupe leader, unable to resist her persistent plea, finally agreed. From then on, a small, lively figure danced among the lions.

Southern Tales II: Sea of Lanterns

Night deepened. Lights glittered in the town's night market. As the twilight lamps were extinguished, the night market's lanterns were hung, illuminating the trees in a brilliant red.

Gongs boomed, suona horns pierced the air—the lion dance commenced. The stage lion leapt high, somersaulting—reaching for the moon—then dipped low, nodding slowly, gazing at the sea of spectators below. She skillfully twisted and turned, maneuvering the lion's snarling head, its mane flying as she danced—a red sprite, more dazzling than the lanterns in the night market. The audience below would clap and cheer for her stunning performance.

Of all the treats in the night market, her favorite was Candied Hawthorn. Tart hawthorns coated in sugar, a perfect blend of sour and sweet—much like her love for the lion dance, irresistible and enchanting. Back then, she never thought about the future, nor did she care. The day's work wasn't finished, the day's candied hawthorn still untouched, and the night market still buzzing—why worry about tomorrow?

And so, amidst the glittering lights of the lantern-filled market, she drifted through one sweet dream after another.

Southern Tales III: Parting Ways

"Where next?" she asked.

"Not sure. Anywhere. I'll find work in the city…" The leader sighed. "I don't know where else to go." Nowhere good."

"Can't we just stay together?" she asked, knowing the answer.

Hardly anyone had watched lion dances anymore. Performances and contests were dwindling, and there seemed to be little reason to continue. Yet she still longed to play that red sprite, to hear the cheers of the crowd. Where to next? She hadn't decided. She had always been a carefree child, leaping from rooftops and walls. But now she felt like her wings were wet, unsure of where to fly.

The last companion left with the lion props. She stared blankly at the empty room. Suddenly, she remembered an ad she'd seen during a performance… perhaps she should explore the unknown? For her restless soul, a new page might be the best choice.

Decision made. What would the future hold? She didn't know, but that didn't matter. When the future is unclear—just fly forward.

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 菲前辈，探索部又来新人了，就是这家伙！我介绍一下啊，她是我的后辈，是——

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 呜呼~瞅瞅奇妙冒险团打卡小队兼新人探索员程橙橙，前来报到！

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 啊，自己说出来了。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 你好，我是引导员菲，这里还有队长和荧荧……你和荧荧好像已经认识了？

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 对！荧荧前辈和我是在瞅瞅奇妙冒险团里认识的。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 瞅瞅奇妙冒险团？我和队长好像在哪里听说过……？

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 噢！真的吗？探索部的前辈们也听说过吗？！

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 哼！哼哼哼哼……哈哈哈哈！

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 怎么啦荧荧前辈——发出了像游戏里第一个出现的看起来很强其实马上就会被一跟脚趾打飞的大反叛发出的笑声！

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 程橙橙说得好快，好厉害——不过和荧荧一样，说得我有点听不懂……

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 没关系的菲前辈，就让我来正式说明一下吧！

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: “瞅瞅奇妙冒险团”又名“瞅瞅团”，意思就是要到处“瞅瞅”的团！

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 我们作为团内成员，专门在网络上收集怪谈传说与神秘事件，之后自发地组成一个团，去当地一探究竟——

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 就是这样的一个网友组成的组织啦！

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 原来如此，所以叫瞅瞅团啊，听起来有点像麦塔。

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 对吧对吧？！我们的调查有时候也会澄清一些谣言——不过倒也发现了许多解释不通的事。

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 比如之前我听说的“眼”现象，那个就很难解释啊……

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 不过，当时看到那样的现象我真是超——感动的！

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 所以才会托联系上荧荧前辈，还有罗塔公司——趁着现在就能来这里兼职探索员真是超——棒啊！

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 是说趁着过节放假吗？那确实会是超——与众不同的假期体验——额……我被传染了？

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 也可以这么说啦！

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 但我说的现在是指——趁着我年纪还小，通过了探索员的测试，而且还在瞅瞅团玩的时候！

Datas.Title: 荧荧
Datas.Content: 啊……？啊——我好酸啊菲姐姐~我突然好酸啊怎么办……

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 荧荧前辈没事吧？怎么扭成一团了像中了debuff一样……我找找看有没有解毒的草药……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 没事的，荧荧有时候会突然这样，习惯就好。

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 既然菲前辈都这么说了……唔……

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 我刚才说话的时候没想太多——其实我觉得吧，年纪，想法，朋友，健康的身体……所有的事其实都像天气一样。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 像天气一样？

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 对啊，你们听过那样一个谜语吧——“清晨是小孩，正午是大人，傍晚是老人。”

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 身体状况也会变得像天气，一会感冒了，像打雷下雨，健康的时候就像爽朗的晴天！

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 朋友们也像天上的云一样，一会聚拢，一会又被风吹散，再聚起来的时候也不会是原来的形状。

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 尤其是我经常和不同的人组成“瞅瞅团”出去玩，这种感觉就超——强烈的！

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 菲前辈？

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 不好意思我走神了……刚才说到哪来着？

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 当然是说到该去空间探索了，新人同学~

Datas.Title: 程橙橙
Datas.Content: 哇——收到！去哪里探索？！我超——快的，马上就回来！

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 还没说去哪儿就跑出去了，这孩子还真是急性子。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 队长可以把她叫回来的，所以芳汀不用担心。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 而且这次要探索的地方，我已经发送到每个人的稳定器了……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 这次要去的是类似F25【水晶球】的小型模拟空间，听说研究员在那里发现了一件很奇妙的事……会是什么呢……

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 我也听说了那件事——

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 研究员在那里发现了“不会融化的雪”。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: “不会融化的雪”？

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 咦？雪不会融化虽然有点奇怪，但是是在空间里……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 空间里的天气一直不会改变，所以雪也不会融化……才对。

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 是啊——现实侧的物质，包括我们，进入空间就都会被转化成斯坦因素，在稳定器的作用下逐渐稳定。

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 但在空间里的东西只有在空间里才不会改变。如果被带出来的话……时间甚至会把变化带回那样东西身上。

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 但是探索员们从那里带出来的雪团却没有发生任何变化，一直保持着雪的样子。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: ……所以才是“不会融化的雪”？

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 没错，研究员现在正在研究这种会在现实侧自然稳定的斯坦因素，需要去空间大量地收集。

Datas.Title: 芳汀
Datas.Content: 听说为了这个，研究部还给大家准备了不少奖励呢。

Datas.Title: 队长
Datas.Content: 想去看看吗，菲？

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 其实刚才程橙橙说那些话的时候，我想到了队长，稍微有些不安。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 因为平时看不见队长，感觉好像随时都会消失掉……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 探索员们大部分兼职，都在忙着各自的事……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 之前听不到队长说话的时候，感觉大家也只是偶尔组队一起探索，好像随时都会见不到了……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 但是现在我突然想到了，就算大家不见了，我不见了……空间也会把我们的回忆保留下来。

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: 我最珍视的回忆，说不定也能像“不会融化的雪”一样……

Datas.Title: 菲
Datas.Content: ……我们一起去看看那样的雪吧，队长！
应该还有其他观测不到的东西……
对可疑的地方【拍照】就可以让它们显露出来了，继续找找吧。
由于之前的庆典事件，这片模拟空间似乎不太稳定……
用【拍照】来稳定观测吧。说不定能发现可以收集的东西。

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Ah… If only I could be an adventurer too…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Is something bothering you?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Listen to me, there's this suuuuuper yummy Field that has only just stabilized. Now it's about to become open for exploration!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Suuuuuuper yummy? Sounds interesting! What's it like?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: It's something I'm suuuuuper into! Boohoo… I don't want to talk about it anymore. I'm dying to…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: There's something you want to do? Don't worry. We can go in there and do it for you. Just tell us!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Boohoo—Fey, I got bullied!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Huh?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: There, there… If you're still too upset to talk about it, I'll fill them in.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: No… I've pulled myself together. I'll be the guardian of what I'm super into!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Capt., Shirley, the new Field you guys are going to look into next is something like a hot pot.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: A hot pot…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Exactly! It looks like the food I'm suuuuper into—[Double-Flavor Hot Pot]!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Double-Flavor Hot Pot?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: It was presumably formed by spatial overlap in a hot pot restaurant—

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: That restaurant has a surprising 100-year history of making hot pot—

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Its signature hot pot is unforgettably tasty. I plan to go and try it during the upcoming vacation—

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: We need to find proof of the hot pot restaurant overlapping Field F20, so that the Research Department might unravel the mysteries surrounding the formation of Fields.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: AAAARGH! You robbed me of my last lines, Fey!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Sorry… I got the sense that it might take you a long while to finish speaking, and I was afraid Capt. and Shirley might run out of patience.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Well, sometimes I can indeed be a bit garrulous… Anyway, that's the whole story.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: I love that hot pot restaurant… Now it's closed because of the Field phenomenon…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: I would give anything to solve the problem for the restaurant! But I'm unable to protect the restaurant I like…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: So I'm counting on you guys!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Got it! The hot pot that Irene is super into, super super into, and super super super into—consider it rescued!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Yeah, for Irene's sake, we must ascertain the truth asap.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: I'm touched—you guys are so sweet!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Moreover, the staff members of the restaurant must be in distress too. I hope we can help them out soon.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: We've reached F20. There are a couple of locations showing signs of stability fluctuation. We can look into them.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: So this is the Double-Flavor Hot Pot…

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Yeah, this is the Field that has only just stabilized: F20, [Double-Flavor Hot Pot].

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: I've never been here before either, but I read the report and knew what it was like… Do you know what hot pot is?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Yeah, I've seen it during my travels! But the Double-Flavor Hot Pot… This is the biggest one I've ever seen!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Well, we're in a Field. Anything can happen here.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: This is one of the target locations. Let's collect some data first—

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: The Ashen Creatures might cause instability to this new Field. Let's dispose of them first.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Looks like the stability changes in this place were caused by these Ashen Creatures. There's nothing else out of the ordinary…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Well, where should we go next?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: The coordinates of the next location are… You look very happy.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Being in a new Field is like embarking on a new adventure, so of course I'm happy.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Besides, we're also helping people. I really look forward to exploring this Field after everything is settled!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Well then, let's ascertain the truth of the overlap that occurred in the hot pot restaurant as soon as we can.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: The description of the commission says a couple of Rota employees have also joined the investigation. They're responsible for extracting data in the restaurant.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: They'll provide us with some coordinates to help us find potentially useful information.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: If we fail to figure out the connection before they fully stabilize the overlap, we might lose the clues about the formation of Fields.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Does that mean we need to act fast? No problem. I'll keep track of time.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: They sent us the coordinates of the new location. It appears to be someplace lower.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Is it that gazebo?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Ah… Yeah! It's so spicy and hot around here. Can we get there?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Spicy and hot? Because everything here is red? Well, this area does look different than the last one.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Come to think of it, one of the colleagues investigating the restaurant seems to have been hospitalized after eating an unduly spicy hot pot.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: It's said he also lost a report. The colleagues who went to the scene afterward failed to find it.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Speaking of the report… I think there's something like that over there.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: This report… It's the one our colleague lost! Its number is the same as that of the electronic document!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Isn't this proof that there's a connection between this Field and the hot pot restaurant?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Ah… That's right! This report contains data recorded by the element. It's perfect for research.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: This means it doesn't matter if the overlap in the restaurant disappears!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Great! Now we've finished our investigation and helped those people out.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Better still, the sight of fine food is quite delightful. Now I know why Irene wants to get in here.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Thanks to the Research Department's efforts, the overlap of the hot pot restaurant and the Field is over!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: All the problems of the hot pot restaurant have been solved, and Meta Research Center has declared the restaurant secure!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Great. This means Irene will get to enjoy hot pot in that restaurant during the vacation!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Aargh—I'm already itching to go… I'll set off immediately when the next vacation starts!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Where are you going? F20?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Fantine, we've only just returned from F20 [Double-Flavor Hot Pot].

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Well, did you guys see the Rota Food Festival's—

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Food festival? I did hear that there's going to be some kind of event during the upcoming vacation… Did something happen?

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Indeed. I need you to come with me.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Ah, okay. Capt., Shirley, I need to get going.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: What's the matter? You need any help?

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Not yet. You guys may take a break and find somewhere to hang out.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Ah, they left. What should we do next? Would you like another visit to that Field, Capt.?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Wait—Allow me to recommend that unforgettable hot pot to you guys! Speaking of that hot pot…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: You guys are not gonna believe this: the Research Department is arguing about "whether Santa Claus really exists".

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Santa Claus? You mean the one who sneaks into every house on Christmas Eve?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Huh? Doesn't that make him a burglar?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Sorry, I shouldn't have put it that way. Santa Claus is not a burglar. He delivers gifts to people.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: I was just joking. I know. It's a custom that originated in western countries.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: But typically Santa Clauses are played by acquaintances, right?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Yeah, nobody in the company plays that role as a regular task, but every year the doctor has the General Affairs Department prepare gifts for all employees.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: —I hope to receive a gaming machine this year!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: If they're on a tight budget, they should at least give me a Golden "Soft" Badge, and I want two if their budget is big enough!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Taking their budget into consideration, I think a gaming machine can only be earned through a prize draw… Have you ever received any Christmas gifts, Shirley?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: I don't have the habit of observing such festivals, but back in the days when I was traveling around, I really looked forward to chancing on Santa!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Huh? You wanted to chance on Santa?! What kind of dream was that?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: It's because I never did chance on him…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: In the northern countries, I met some people who played Santa as part of their jobs, but I think the real Santa must be someone of a much earlier time.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Shh!!! You don't want the Research Department to hear that! They're searching for that old man in red like crazy!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Well, did they find him?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: They didn't, which was why they started arguing! Anything can happen in the Fields, but there's no Santa Claus. They find it heartbreaking.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: So you guys are talking about F25. They did seem to receive a report like that…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: F25? You mean the strange Field they've discovered recently? We haven't visited it yet, I think.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: That's right. As it's quite Christmassy, all the researchers are wondering if Santa Claus is in there.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Now my curiosity is piqued as well. Let's go and check it out! F… Uh, what's the name of that Field again?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: F25, a snowy [Crystal Ball]—Sounds very Christmassy, doesn't it?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Whoa! We're in the [Crystal Ball]! Amazing! I've never seen anything like this before!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Snowflakes, Christmas trees, gift boxes, toys… This place is perfect for Christmas!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: I can't agree more, but because of the controversy about Santa, many people are unwilling to explore this place.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: What a shame. Besides, refusing to explore this place will only make it harder to be sure!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Well, I'd like to verify it with my own eyes. I'll explore this Field carefully. Maybe Santa is indeed in here somewhere…

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: If we find him, the Research Department… No, I think everybody will be happy about it.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: But chances are that we won't be able to find him, given how long they've been searching for him…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Even if we fail to find him, this trip of ours will be a rewarding one—I've made a lot of such trips before!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Let's go somewhere higher. Capt. says we'll be able to see far away if we adjust the depth of field in the observational settings.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Look at that Christmas tree! Let's get to the top of it!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: It's so high up here… Ah, there!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Guys, look—there's a sleigh flying in the sky!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: In the story, Santa drives a sleigh like that to deliver gifts to people on Christmas Eve…

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: But that sleigh is driverless. Still, it'll be rather weird if there's someone living here…

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: If there's indeed a Santa in F25, will he count as an Ashen Creature?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: With that thought in mind, I think it'll be better if there's no Santa.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Um—not necessarily. I mean, whoever gets on that sleigh will be Santa, right?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: I didn't think of seeing it that way!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: In that case, every visitor in this Field can be Santa Claus!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: But Santa's most important task is to offer gifts. The things we collected can hardly be gifts…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Indeed. We don't have anything decent enough to be a gift in our bag… But at least we've created some memories!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: I made it to the top of a tree with Fey and Capt., where we enjoyed a panoramic view of the whole Crystal Ball—that's a very happy memory!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Yeah, it is!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: It's said that this Field was formed after the designs of those children in Rogers stabilized.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: They planned to build a Simulated Field with those designs, but for some reason, it got synced to a real Field and became like this.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Well, what a shame. If those kids could come here, they would definitely be thrilled.

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: If only we could give our memories of this place to them as a gift…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Well, why don't we go share with them our stories of exploration in this place?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: All we need to do is spread to them the happiness we felt when exploring this place!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Ah, but…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Are you worried the kids might be upset if they know there's no Santa?

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: Then let's not tell them… We'll just pretend not to have been here!

Datas.Title: Fey
Datas.Content: But I'll still deliver our investigation report to the Research Department.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Huh? It might be better if you don't…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: What a thick document pouch. This must be the last one. Let me see what it's about…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: —Investigation Report on "Isle of Moon"—Isn't this the one that…

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Irene, do you have the last document?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Sorry!!! I shouldn't have let my curiosity get the better of me! I'm sorry… Boohoo…

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Why are you being so dramatic about it? I didn't say anything.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Is this a classified document? Am I, a lowly assistant, not allowed to read it?

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: I would've kept it to myself if it were important. My trusting you with it, naturally, means that you can read it.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: You may tell them what they're supposed to know—Just withhold what they're not supposed to know.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Given how fast a reader you are, you've finished the whole report, I presume?

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Yeah, but my brother says there are some things it's better for me to pretend not to know, which is why I didn't say anything!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: He's indeed a competent member of the Archive Department. He knows very well what he's supposed to know and what he's not supposed to know.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: But why does Fey seem not to know about it? I thought Capt. and the others were the only ones who didn't need to know…

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: The doctor doesn't like that troublesome stuff, so she doesn't want Fey to know too much about them.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Besides, as you saw, the matter of Saki alone depressed her. She would overthink it.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: But this kind of thing… It's just weird! I've seen the rumor on Nutjob before…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: But I thought the Fields were the only things we were keeping secret. It never crossed my mind that there were real cases.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Meta, not us. You need to remember that these things have nothing to do with Rota.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: But people have gone missing because of the Fields!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: And it's not an isolated incident! It happens yearly! The most serious incident even involved a dozen missing persons!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: So many missing person cases have happened in that tourist attraction, and yet they're actually regarded as an old wives' taleta!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: And the local government is still releasing hype videos about tourism and sacrificial fetes, trying to attract more tourists!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: —Shouldn't we just call the police and put those people on social news?!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: And tell the public the cause was Over Field and everybody must stay aletart? The whole world would panic.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: But at least there will be fewer people going there. I don't want anybody else to go missing…

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: That's above our pay grade. We'd better leave that to professionals.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: But we're professional Field handlers, aren't we? We can do something about it, like stabilize the Field.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Many incidents described in the reports were dealt with that way, weren't they? All it takes is for Rota to intervene!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: On the premise that—Rota can intervene.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: They're not going to do anything about it? I can't believe this!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Maybe you should guess whether there are people who don't want us to intervene.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: I remember reading about a local organization in the report… Is it them?!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: The investigation into the "Isle of Moon" has been ongoing for many years, and the issue has existed just as long.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: We join hands with Meta and the special investigation unit of the Astral Coterie regularly to look into it.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Even so the problem still remains unsolved, and there's… a reason for it.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Otherwise the thick document pouch in your hands wouldn't have existed.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: So we're working with Meta against an evil organization lurking in the shadows…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: —That sounds so cool! Like the plot of a video game!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: You… cheered up surprisingly quickly.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: I'm just happy to know we're the good guys! I mean no disrespect to the missing people!

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: We'll be able to solve it if we exert ourselves, right? Well then, I'll pull out all the stops!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Alright, deliver this back to the Archive Department and then pay a visit to the Technology and the Administration Departments.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Someone drafted a proposal about improving Stabilizer Loops for independent exploration after finishing their draft of some regulations about independent exploration…

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Whoa! The director is such a selfless man! But… why didn't he do it sooner?

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: There have always been many independent adventurers. It's just Saki's case was exceptional.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: The interim measure only required her to return to the company regularly, and that was… enough.

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: Well, off you go. They should be back soon.

Datas.Title: Irene
Datas.Content: Oh, okay! See you!

Datas.Title: Fantine
Datas.Content: No matter which one it is, it's worth "resuming" the research… —That's probably what she thinks.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Saki, you're here as well. What a coincidence!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Are you guys here for a stroll?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Um—not exactly. I kind of feel like fishing or collecting some seafood…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: —Anyway, I felt like coming here, so I came!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: You always put your ideas into action without a second thought.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Well, I want to thank you guys again for your help the other day. I probably wouldn't have made it back were it not for you guys.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: That's not true. I mean, eventually you got out of there by yourself, didn't you?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: You didn't give up. You pondered what you did best and figured out a way, which was really impressive.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But I don't think I would've made it back had you guys not entered that Aberrant Field.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Still, thanks to that incident, I've decided to do what I want to do.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Mm, I'm glad to hear that!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Well, is a stroll on the beach the thing you want to do right now?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Hehe, do I look like I'm strolling? I'm just gazing in that direction—

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That direction, on the other side of the sea… lies the island that is my hometown.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: So the Skyroot Isle is that way.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Could you tell me what your hometown is like?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Sure, but my story of that place is rather ordinary. I hope you won't find it boring.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That place has always been called the "Isle of Moon". Some say it's because the island's shape resembles that of the moon; others say it's because the island boasts a perfect view of the moon.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But actually, it's just a very, very small islet. You can't tell its shape on a map.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It has a population of only 400-odd, and merely 200 of them or so actually live on the islet.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: —But that place used to be the whole world to me as a child.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Everybody lives an ordinary life there. Everybody has… their own place.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Their own place? You mean everybody has a job? That's very nice.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Everybody has a role designed for them, and all they have to do is play their part.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Some people manage shrines; some hold ceremonies; some entertain guests…

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Some play the children; some play the parents; some do business…

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Some supervise others, and some… make those arrangements.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Huh? Those things can be arranged?

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: I thought everybody had their own ideas and did what they wanted to do.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: My hometown is just an islet. There aren't many jobs. Only through seamless teamwork can the little community operate.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: That kind of makes sense… But some of the jobs you just mentioned strike me as a bit strange…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: I've never seen people play children or parents in real life. Are their relations not real?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: They are, but their feelings… are not.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: What kind of parent would feel no pain when their child comes to grief?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But my father… That man was totally indifferent when my big sister went missing.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: How could that be? Were they on bad terms?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: They didn't use to be… But after he developed his belief in "that thing", everything changed.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: "That thing"? I remember you saying that your people offered sacrifices to the moon. Is that what you're referring to?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: No… Well, yes, in a sense.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: We used to believe in the "Sky Moon", aka "Sky Eye", "Black Moon".

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That's the Oculus phenomenon. Even to this day, some people still believe in it, but their belief is not purely a belief anymore.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Their belief is not purely a belief? I don't quite understand…

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It's more like a local superstition—Or maybe I should say their minds are controlled—by that person—[Barnacle Lord].

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Barnacles are the kind of animals that parasitize other marine life, right? They feed on their hosts.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yeah… That person… and the organization he founded—[Barnacles]—are in de facto control of Skyroot Isle.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Is this [Barnacle Lord] guy really that powerful?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: No… I don't know… But my elders believe he really did bring prosperity to Skyroot Isle.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Due to the "Sky Eye", Skyroot Isle used to be ignored by other places.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: There was no tourism or investment. When all other places were developing, that island remained stagnant.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It was the [Barnacle Lord] who brought in investment, injecting funds into education and medical care.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It was also he who arranged everything that enabled residents of Skyroot Isle to enjoy the same life that people of other places had been enjoying.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Um… Sounds like he did a great thing.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yes, it was indeed a great thing for the islanders.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But he also required us to do his bidding—it's like some kind of religion.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: In my hometown, many people instinctively believe everything the Barnacle Lord says.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: In recent years he has made the ceremony an open event for out-of-towners, turning it into a tourist project.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Thus the Skyroot Isle became a tourist attraction, and my people have been earning a lot of money by entertaining the tourists.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But at the same time… the number of missing people is rising by the year. It's just that the islanders are no longer among the missing.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Therefore, the islanders trust him even more deeply now, regarding him as a god.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Even the news reports about missing persons were hushed up by his money…

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Those tourists and Saki's sister—he's actually feeding on them for money like a barnacle on its host!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yeah, I was thinking the same thing, which was why I once tried to talk my father into stopping him—

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But I failed. There was nothing I could do… And I was unwilling to think about it anymore. I shied away.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It was Rota Corporation, the shred of hope I had of finding my sister, that helped me summon up the courage to flee the island.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: I want to… find my sister, instead of letting these efforts of mine become some sort of attempted escape from that place.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: We'll figure something out! I'm sure you'll find your sister!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Fey and I and everybody else in Rota will make sure your efforts are not in vain!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Thank you. Thank you for being indignant about this matter like I am.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: The day will come when we'll go back to your hometown together and face up to that [Barnacle Lord] guy!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yeah, I look forward to that.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: How very nice. You're like my motivator. I'm sure you'll also become everybody else's motivator.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: —May you inspire everybody to do what they want to do.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: By the way, I figured out the answer to that riddle.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Is the answer "moon"? The "moon" in the sky that you talked about!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: You guessed right. Yeah, the answer is moon.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: But why did they devise that riddle? Does it refer to that particular ceremony?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Actually, that riddle involves a piece of Skyroot Isle's history.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: The "Sky Moon", aka the "Sky Eye", is a god worshipped by my people on Skyroot Isle.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: The Sky Moon is dangerous, but it has been above Skyroot Isle since ancient times. People fear it.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That's why our esteemed ancestor, Fujimori, used the word "Eye" to denote the obscured "Moon".

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That name also told people that they could survive the Moon by simply keeping their eyes closed.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Over time they dismissed their fear, and they started using the form of address "His Excellency the Sky Eye" to denote the Sky Moon.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: But I think this Sky Moon thing is called the "Oculus phenomenon" in our company.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: The name corresponds to the word "eye"! They both denote eyes!

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That's quite a coincidence. I was surprised too when I first heard of it. I didn't know the phenomenon was ubiquitous.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Yeah, maybe I have seen it somewhere before as well and I just didn't pay much attention to it.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It's said that many times the Oculus phenomenon doesn't do any damage. It doesn't necessarily cause people to go missing.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It depends on the extent and range of the spatial overlapping. I didn't know until I joined this company.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: So those in your hometown worship it because they fear going missing, right?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yeah… The Sky Eye Shrine on Skyroot Isle was built for that very purpose.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: The Sky Eye Shrine? I don't remember you mentioning it before.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: The Sky Eye Shrine is the most important shrine for sacrificial activities on Skyroot Isle. Its managers are also responsible for organizing and conducting the ceremonies.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Ever since the time of Fujimori Skyroot, the ceremony in which attendees blindfold themselves to see the moon off has been passed down from generation to generation.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Fujimori Skyroot? Is everybody on the island surnamed Skyroot?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: No, it's just that the Skyroot family has always been the protectors of the Sky Eye Shrine.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: So you're a member of that family?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yeah, I watched those ceremonies as I grew up.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: So… I know who went missing.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: Fey once said the Oculus phenomenon has something to do with the Fields. Does that mean those missing people might've ended up in the Fields?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Maybe. Come to think of it, there's this legend that I believe is quite worth mentioning.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: A legend? Legends are rumors that go from mouth to mouth. They're not necessarily true.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: That's right. Legend has it that a teenage girl, to help the one taken in the ceremony come back, brought some camellia seeds and sowed them at the roadside.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Because the Sky Eye always appears on moonless winter nights, and camellias bloom at the same time. Their fragrance might guide the missing people home.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: What a heartwarming legend! But it seems to have nothing to do with Fields.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: But there had been no camellias on Skyroot Isle. The one who brought the camellia seeds was our ancestor Fujimori.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: According to the story passed down in my clan, he was waiting for a girl to return from the "moon".

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: It makes the "moon" sound like a Field.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Yeah. I think he was just hoping that might happen… Just like I am…

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: I hope my sister will come back to me—if it's true that "Everything you've lost can be recovered in Fields"—

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: You've said that before, Saki. Is it a famous saying or something?

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: It's said to be a quotation from Mrs. Rota's manuscript. A gentleman from out of town told me that.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: He was a writer of web literature, who seemed to be looking into the Field-related incidents in various places all along, writing stories about them and publishing them online.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Thanks to him, I made it here with a glimmer of hope… Not until now did I see real hope.

Datas.Title: Saki
Datas.Content: Hehe, it was clearly a world of nights I ventured into, but I felt like I found the light of hope in it.

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: You look very happy, Saki. I'm sure you'll be even happier when you find your sister!

Datas.Title: Shirley
Datas.Content: And when that moment comes, I promise we'll be by your side to bear witness!

Event Overview: The season of Hot Pot is here! In this sizzling event, you'll collect ingredients to craft Hot Pot Ingredient Packs, pour them into the giant Hot Pot in the Rota Garden to claim Mini Hot Pots, which can be exchanged for great rewards in the Event Shop. Event Content: 1. Ingredient Collection: You'll need to collect the following three hot pot ingredients: Hot Pot Soup Base Vegetable Platter Fresh Meat Slices There are three ways to obtain ingredients: Scene dungeons and Encounter Battle chests Complete daily quests Participate in event dungeons Each way yields a different amount of ingredients. Adjust your strategy based on your needs to maximize the efficiency. 2. How to Get Mini Hot Pots: Combine the three ingredients collected into a Hot Pot Ingredient Pack. Head to the hotpot stage at the center of the Rota Garden and pour the ingredients into the giant soup pots on either side to get a Mini Hot Pot, which can be exchanged for event rewards! 3. Event Dungeon [Fragrant Steamer]: During the event, you can claim 3 event dungeon challenge tickets per day through daily quests. Dungeon Gameplay: Face off against the powerful dungeon Boss: [Giant Crimson Lionhead]! Defeat it to open a treasure chest and claim rich rewards! This Boss boasts high damage resistance and is able to launch long-range charge attacks! Traps are randomly scattered in the dungeon—they can deal damage to both you and the Boss! Battle Tip: When the Boss charges toward you, trigger traps to make it lose a huge amount of HP and fall into the Break state, temporarily losing its DMG reduction—that's your moment to strike! Note: A challenge ticket is consumed each time you defeat the Boss and open the chest. 4. Event Shop: During the event, Jean by the Hot Pot Stage will handle both reward exchanges and dungeon entry. Have fun in the hot pot carnival and stock up on goodies! Don't forget to join the dungeons and ingredient collection events! Good luck and enjoy your hot pot!
